Sean Wilentz, a professor of American History at Princeton University, makes the stakes of the SAVE Act clear: “ It’s the most extraordinary attack on voting rights in American history .”
We MUST stop this bill in the Senate and more like it, but we need to unite and fight now, before opponents of voting rights in Congress start checking voter suppression bills off their to-do list.
RUSH $25 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103025_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
CBS: Experts warn the proposed SAVE Act could make it harder for some married women to vote. Here's who could be affected. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103025_3&amount=25]
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point.
PITCH IN $25 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103025_3&amount=25]
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

name: Connor Miller
subject: Sarah is counting on us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
It’s Connor, Sarah’s Finance Director.
#
Hi, it’s Connor. I’m the Finance Director for Sarah’s campaign.
It’s my job to make sure Sarah has the resources to fight like hell for Delawareans, compete next November, and help flip the House.
The midterms might feel far off, but our work is already underway, and here’s the truth: **Our fundraising is falling behind where it should be.** On top of that, our end-of-month fundraising deadline hits tomorrow at midnight.
To help catch up, Sarah and I set a goal to raise $20,000 before midnight tomorrow. But we’re still $13,000 short.
[**I’m starting to get nervous — but I know that supporters like you have always had Sarah’s back. Can you please pitch in $5 or anything else before tomorrow night’s deadline?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251030-1.95OkLu&refcode=em20251030-2458&amount=5&t=1&akid=2458%2E21716%2EXPzTbw)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251030-1.95OkLu&amount=5&refcode=em20251030-2458&t=2&akid=2458%2E21716%2EXPzTbw)**
Sarah’s counting on us to power this campaign so she can keep her focus on fighting for us in Congress at a time when our freedoms and futures are on the line.
She doesn’t have billionaires on speed dial to write her checks when our fundraising slows. She’s relying on this grassroots team.
And now is _not_ the time to fall short. MAGA is _obsessed_ with Sarah, and they’re watching every dollar we raise. We need to show them we’re standing strong with Sarah — and that they can’t intimidate her or us, no matter how hard they try.
[**I know if everyone reading this contributes even a little, we’ll hit this goal and show everyone, including MAGA, that we’re not going anywhere! Can you chip in now?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251030-1.95OkLu&refcode=em20251030-2458&amount=5&t=3&akid=2458%2E21716%2EXPzTbw)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251030-1.95OkLu&amount=5&refcode=em20251030-2458&t=22&akid=2458%2E21716%2EXPzTbw)**
I’d love to tell Sarah that you, along with hundreds of other supporters, stepped up today!
— Connor

Hi null,

It’s Haley here, and I want to say this up front: **This is the most important moment of our campaign so far.** We have a critical end-of-month $350,000 goal we need to reach by midnight tomorrow, and we’re still falling short.
So I’m asking directly, if you’re able: **[Will you chip in $5 today to help us reach our goal, win this race, and keep Michigan blue?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7864?t=3&akid=1243%2E49239%2EEIhjL1)**
But I also know this is a really hard time for so many people. That’s why I want to take a moment to talk about why this moment matters – and what’s really at stake.
✅ **Health care costs are spiking** thanks in part to the GOP’s “Big Beautiful Budget” bill, which slashed health care funding. Now, premiums are skyrocketing. Families are opening their mail to find out they’ll be paying _hundreds more per month_ just to stay covered.
✅ **We’re almost a month into the government shutdown,** and thousands of federal workers and contractors across Michigan have already gone weeks without pay. They don’t know when they’ll get their next paycheck. But rent is due. Bills don’t shut down. And MAGA Republicans and Donald Trump have done nothing.
✅ **On Nov. 1, over 42 million Americans – including 1.4 million Michiganders – will lose access to SNAP benefits** if the shutdown continues. That means kids will go to bed hungry in the richest country in the world. It’s shameful. It’s cruel. And it’s avoidable.
This is all deliberate. It’s not just Washington dysfunction. It’s a political strategy – designed by Donald Trump and carried out by his MAGA enablers in Congress.

And if that wasn’t enough, Trump is now openly signaling that he won’t leave office in 2028. His closest advisors are laying the groundwork for him to ignore the Constitution and claim a third term.
We’ve heard this kind of language before in other countries. And we know where it leads.

_So what do we do?_ **We win.**
The most powerful check we have left on Trump and his Republican allies is winning big in the 2026 midterms. We need to take back the Senate. And it starts right here in Michigan.

That’s the heart of why I’m running.**To fight for Michigan families who feel forgotten.** To protect our democracy from Trump’s authoritarian plans. To put working people first – and to never, ever stop fighting for the folks who are being tossed aside.
**But I can’t do this alone.** **
We’ve set a $350,000 end-of-month goal, and I’m counting on you to help me get there by midnight tomorrow.** Every dollar we raise will go straight to building the kind of grassroots campaign we need to reach voters in every corner of the state.
**[So if you’re with me – if you believe we can stop Trump and flip the Senate for Democrats – will you chip in $5 now?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7864?t=4&akid=1243%2E49239%2EEIhjL1)**

| | Peter, Washington is in chaos again. And once more, it’s YOU, the American taxpayer, who’s left footing the bill.
While most of us are sick of the dysfunction, Democrats are celebrating it and cashing in on it.
Within hours of the government shutdown, Democrats were blasting out fundraising emails, urging their donors to “fight the Republicans” and “defend the Schumer Shutdown agenda.” They’ve raised millions off the back of this crisis.
Meanwhile, Congressman Mike Lawler has been doing what the people of NY-17 elected him to do: focus on results, not rhetoric.
He’s one of the few in Congress willing to reach across the aisle to keep our government open, fighting to make sure essential services are there for you and your family, strengthening border security, and protecting taxpayers from political games. But here’s the reality:
* Democrat PACs are already flooding the airwaves.
* National liberal groups are organizing early to flip this seat.
* And eight Democrat challengers are lining up, hoping chaos gives them a chance to take down one of the most effective bipartisan voices in Congress.

We’re approaching the October End-of-Month deadline, and this report will be one of the most closely watched filings of the entire election cycle. If we fall short, the media and the left will use it to say Mike Lawler’s campaign is losing momentum.
We can’t let that happen.
Mike Lawler doesn’t take cues from party bosses or special interests. He listens to the people of the Hudson Valley. But to stay in this fight, he needs grassroots supporters like you standing with him.
If you’ve ever wondered whether your contribution makes a difference, this is the moment when it truly does.

| | Peter – this email might be a little long, but I wanted to reach out to you personally to share some thoughts about our race.

I am deeply appreciative of the outpouring of support I received following the announcement that a wealthy venture capitalist with deep pockets was trying to buy our Congressional seat.

I am proud of the grassroots support we have built. Two-thirds of our support comes from our district and 75 percent of our donations are $250 or less. And, I am honored to have earned the endorsement of more than 230 sheriffs, mayors, supervisors, district attorneys, superintendents, city council members, school board members as well as business, labor, non-profit, tribal and community leaders from across our district.

Unfortunately, after calling all of his ultra wealthy friends outside our district and bankrolling his campaign with nearly $150,000 of his money, **we were outraised last quarter.**

Peter, I’m going to be honest. Campaigns are expensive. To win this race we’ll need to invest in TV ads, direct mail, digital ads, supporting our volunteers as they knock on doors and make phone calls, and more. This will be even more crucial when we pass Prop 50 and I’m facing a new district where I’ll have to introduce myself to new voters.

**But, I know that together, we can win.**

My team and I are working very hard to raise the resources needed to compete and win this election cycle, so that I can continue our work together to address our district’s most pressing needs. But I need your help.

**_[Please donate anything you can today, and join the hundreds of grassroots donors from across our district. This campaign is powered by the people and we’ll need your support to keep going.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118344703/579467378/443030563?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_MT_20251030_FR_EOM_0_6MO_MikeThompson_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjBmMGUzMy1mM2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rRIHLbip5dvG2G_S4rZ0KPEb1JzhNlxs4avJuDM2vVs=)_**

I will never treat my supporters like an ATM. I will always be clear about why I need your support and what your contributions are going toward.

From addressing rising costs to making housing more affordable to defending our democracy and so much more, there’s so much work to get done.

Serving my community in Congress is an honor and a privilege and I can’t do it without you.

Please consider making a contribution today: **_[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mt-october-25](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118344704/579467379/443030563?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_MT_20251030_FR_EOM_0_6MO_MikeThompson_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjBmMGUzMy1mM2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rRIHLbip5dvG2G_S4rZ0KPEb1JzhNlxs4avJuDM2vVs=)_**

Mike

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251030em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251030em]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251030em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251030em]
You’ve seen the headlines — Portland called “a war zone.” Threats to send in troops. Sneers about “law and order” from people who have never once stood in line at a Portland food pantry, staffed a polling place in Multnomah County, or walked a voter through how to cure a signature on their ballot.
Here’s the truth: Portland is resilient, creative, and stubbornly democratic. When extremists try to turn our city into a prop, the real target is your right to vote and your confidence in our elections.
That’s why, as these headlines ricochet, I’m asking you to help us meet a clear, practical goal: raise $20,000 by midnight on October 31. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251030em] Not for theatrics — for the work.
Your contribution powers the concrete guardrails that keep Oregonians in charge of Oregon:
* Rapid legal response when Washington tries to pry open private voter data.
* County-level support to process ballots securely and quickly — including overtime for election staff.
* Efforts to correct lies about vote-by-mail and ballot drop sites before they spread.

## ****US, China Strike Trade Deals
President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping [reached a one-year ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtutDAQBeCnMZ2Rb1y2cPE3dPu3KdEsHvAkBq_MLGTfPiKvkOY0R_p0dD7u4x0o0bb8hxU9z3nc8NwTMmMZX_sUaYOAkAK8Ey2RdzhoW0ajTCO1klaPASi9R1cFPyMatBV63bX6phrVdFX0Dvo-2Da0rut681BtEyar7WNum64LpqnIX5pWVmulnHa1MrPqm9Y5MOaGTgmnMBDnUn9m2jjinN75wFJPea2Sj8zPXdh_wgzCDOd51tP2mK5SmOGihRm0EmawV3B5rU_5TXLPL47yKxcEWaCgRCgcJUOheZZcIKA8ocjtoEBQR15TVXx4npQS7W0nnFpWoPS7gv903eHNTwAAAP__aA2BGQ)[trade truce](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtutDAQBeCnMZ2Rb1y2cPE3dPu3KdEsHvAkBq_MLGTfPiKvkOY0R_p0dD7u4x0o0bb8hxU9z3nc8NwTMmMZX_sUaYOAkAK8Ey2RdzhoW0ajTCO1klaPASi9R1cFPyMatBV63bX6phrVdFX0Dvo-2Da0rut681BtEyar7WNum64LpqnIX5pWVmulnHa1MrPqm9Y5MOaGTgmnMBDnUn9m2jjinN75wFJPea2Sj8zPXdh_wgzCDOd51tP2mK5SmOGihRm0EmawV3B5rU_5TXLPL47yKxcEWaCgRCgcJUOheZZcIKA8ocjtoEBQR15TVXx4npQS7W0nnFpWoPS7gv903eHNTwAAAP__aA2BGQ) in South Korea on Thursday, de-escalating a dispute that had threatened to grow into a full-blown trade war. As part of the agreement, China pledged to [pause export controls on vital rare earths](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuO4zAQBNDTUJmMZov6BQw2UeZNNxRosyX2gh-Datvj2w80V5i4UA-o-nddr44j5_2vS2RlK2um9xFJhOr6PO6Bs_PkonefyHuQw7047ysC9q2GttOrdxw_q2m83YiQuoasHgc9Qw_92ARLN0OG5p70cO_I-G6D0c9IN0fDPMGtYXtqGjqtAYw2F8ANpn4wxiHOZEAZIM9S6uV_4SyBtvgpL6qXe0lNtEHkcajuj8JF4SKBAsd4ZgqXUBKdgxQuzifOfEh1wiUrXPp-gnnCVuozPdovbhORcN5bt1eiRFnOWlOtf7w5Rj6GURnYk-MfvZFf3fWy-B0AAP__kvR_Jg) for one year, while the U.S. agreed to cut tariffs on Chinese goods related to fentanyl in half, from 20% to 10%. The U.S. also agreed to postpone a rule [blacklisting majority-owned](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE9jMqN2Y5ghcLAJ2d90Q9TYDfRfYxD2DJrbr9gr_KykKj1V1Z-v8YskSlp-08auzPuY-MqRS-FzfGW_SqLAFAN9oixryfSWtIwI2GoDujFjIImf0VbBzczITcXOPDrTQwvto1qdDZ6w6Z7GMAQbaAbT-84-7fToW8RQibtpBhpjAKyxNeAMz7azlhB7tqAscJCyn_X3LqmsPMfP_uaz9vtWRbeWcmTV_FI4KByu66p9mvxtKhxutMIBmlt3CodX1lMk_zdKLlm3oO-JnFn7fTsoCWctSU8SdNm1f52Tnli-JS1Zk9zhQ3s6aJIoRTjXa9lidbpwXBKj5O6hLCwbSfzfrvzo0rfDfwEAAP__FrqJ1Q) Chinese companies, and both sides agreed to suspend fees on docked ships for a year. Additionally, China has agreed to purchase [25 million metric tons of U.S. soybeans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ_G7rCGAf-koNjGXbbd0pqYwbDCEBmSyG9_5bzCrc_ROfq-f_flTiGGtP2lnU11eUn8KZFr5WN5ldWHRJYpWjpj2Hwt9A5pWxCwFxKEkoulEM9Ft9Y4ZmTVspHjIG_QQz-23kzaTY9ppJsc1GN6gLVysqtDDW60crVtMNeaBCUlgJa6A3Qw9YPWhHhjDY0GtqHmo_ufQ6qeXTzzm49uzXsbja_1WRr1p8G5wdmFRGnl7iSf89VocL6QGpy_MIK2g7mI5-tYPRUW2Is9xBhyElIhgsZBdb7usT2MfX6uqAxjo2HbKcTvZ_2VqLfBnwAAAP___Ox7xw) annually for the next three years, according to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. ## Dallas Ordinances Targeted in Lawsuit
The Texas Public Policy Foundation, an Austin-based conservative think tank, filed a lawsuit on Wednesday against the city of Dallas, seeking to [invalidate 83 local ordinances](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO4zAMQE9jdwpESUnsQsU27rLtlgYj0bEAxjZEbj63HzgYzAWmfiTxHv9dxgsWLsvtL94p6mtax4WewqRKdcyEOotiZXzK_6JrYdkKM47OuqMBazyMGQu_x9DmeLW5h5YinE_Q2y500M7Rdf4YQn9FN2EINnTYncEmlwkt-YBtifsxsB4ALDh7OKXgCHsfJuiB0rkJlnLRtR50JqUXysTv9UH1kNZ7y3FW3aTxfxo3NG7IyIxCr62SyD7RuCEVff8g8x1j0ozMtNxIzCfU7KU7NTpXQqVFTOfNvmzWmsuCSyJp3NDWmLdnYS5y2u1udyz8kdHfvfAR3VcAAAD__xeeiGI) that allegedly conflict with state law. Some of the ordinances pertain to employee pay for city contractors and the treatment of LGBTQ residents. The suit, brought on behalf of three Dallas residents, targets the ordinances on the basis of the Texas Regulatory Consistency Act, a 2023 state law that [restricts local regulations](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkEGuozAMQE8TdqnilEJZZNENu_81u5FmgwxxSiRDUGLK75x-RK8wO0vPenr276_hCyPH9fmNCzn5CWlY6ShMIpQHTyhzEcyMR9mjpMhli8w4WGNvGoy-wuAx8nuoK-9G4zuoyEHbQGfu9R2q2Y0AFm_Y3lrvO5jG2ge6-9vUBAwdjFBFd8rAXAHAgDWXZqotYXetA3RAU6tqQz5KyheZSegHS-B3elG-TGmp2M0iW1HXh7K9sv1xHJelrCdTtqdV70XZ_jxK2f4ze2TGostOXp8a7dNfWotOQU9R3jrvTCcuG01y7gT9iolR4vrURVBIMx7K9pj14wG_8p_vvsrOb0dkjqU5g58LRv70yf999eXsvwAAAP__xUWO5g) from exceeding those specified by state law. Proponents of the law said it was necessary to undo a "patchwork" of local regulations across the state, while opponents—who dubbed it the "Death Star" law—argued it [violates local autonomy](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0buu2zAMBuCnsTcFknxJMmjo4u107WjQEp0QZSRDZOKTty8cFH2BbrwAP_GBv77mLyCmfPsJDwz6vZY54y6MqljnhKB3UagMuzxJC7FsxAyzt34wzprOzQmI33PfprDYdHUtBnce3dVe-otr78FHGJIffedThKUfhss6wHBZz4PFfsGxpXCEOds556zz9jTG3iNcu351V4fx3PQWE2mpJ72j4jfIyu_ywnqK5dFyuKtu0nQ_Gj81ftr3_fSUA3GsGz8dZeOnBUWNKCge3Sem8RNUpcif0T-Sbfz0F2wE8bcYLea4p8-aTQJmEFNqogw5opiNgbLSuooReJsXFQZFw7CbBXKmfDNbLbeKIvRCsxWmSChtDWnbiZlkPIy3BxB_SPp_j3gF_ycAAP__iG-h3A). A Travis County judge ruled the law unconstitutional, but an appeals court [overturned that ruling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2S4yAQhU8jZbgAYQ0KCDZxNptuqGpDy-raFqigPfLcfkveI0zaP1997_35nD-BmPLjN2wY5LWUOePRGEWwzglB1iZQGY72JCnEbSdmmK22V2W0GsycgPh7dn0Kd50m02MwH6OZtHfe9GvAq9PexfF6v3vvF-2cv04jgDejGaJzPYUTZvRgjNHG6ssYnUWYBreYyWD86JzGRFLqRVYUfEFb-Lt8Yb3EsvUcVpG9dcOvzt46ezuO4_L3BflcdvZ2puns7f2m9sIkFM8B7DsCNxXLs4p67mvh1NT_M4ZDMW0klB8qkhA2hXkpNeKGWVRZFJcIrEpNlCFHPIl9DWk_iJnaeDo_NiB-K8rPiv0K9l8AAAD__-PlkIo) in July. ## Houston Ship Channel Expansion Marks Milestone
Port Houston announced it has completed its portion of a $1.2 billion project to [expand the Houston Ship Channel](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OozAQRZ8GOpBn7PBTuNiG7tt2SzSxh2DJYMuehOTtV9lX2PpK9xydPz_rD4UYzsdvOtjKe0vryVeNLMJl9UyyV6ES6arPICnEmkOMtKLCWweq07B6CvGzmtbbu_IztGxhHGBWk5mg3S0h-3GYnRk0uom08ej0bXMDTGRmw22w3zNQGgAUoOoHZ5Bp1maDGdiNjVHsg6TSy87Cb6pb_KQXl96lo412F8m10b8aXBpcruvq3V7S-V0bXO7PGk6utcGFigQXucElpyLdnp5V0tnxO9NZQzo7l44cWbhDABz1berznttifb5CjKEOX5fHQSH-Q8v_BXtZ_BsAAP__gDiA-w) through Galveston Bay from 530 feet to 700 feet. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is expected to complete its portion by 2029. Planning for the expansion began in 2010, but dredging didn't start until 2022. The project enhances safety and efficiency for larger ships and [extends the transit window](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2upDAQBODTQGbkNgw_gYNNyGbTDZHHbnBLxkZ2D8zcfsW7wstLpa_q33N5GgoUt79mR82fNS0RrxKQGfPi0LAvbHIwV3kTJwrloBDMoqR6CJCihcUZCt-lq51-STdBjRqGHiY5diPUXk9jj7YbEHr7sC949Q6UcXYY-xGdlY-a9F0GsgUACUo2ve0UmqntVpgA7VB1Eh1xyg17ZPyYsoZvOjE3Nu110J75KFX7p1Jzpebrupo1I22eL3NiuUOVmu9VlZqPlFn49C6corBpPwIyFlE8HcJ6EyMG4TK6jeImzE5OYDwpp7hjZBNEsfnNFL911u64KAQq_Q3cdkPhx8O_e_HU6n8AAAD__zZWi9A) for daylight-restricted vessels by two and a half hours. The 52-mile Houston Ship Channel is the busiest waterway in the United States, and Port Houston [leads the nation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO4yAQBOCnMV0sFohjFxTXuMu1V1ob2IQ9EWOZTUje_uR7hb-f-UaaP9flipx5ffzGJ3n53MuyUquZRGhfIqGkKrhnbPXFUjjXjXPGxWhzPoE-WVgicv4uTkV_03ECRR4uA0x6dCOo5N054BiHEWkEjHaKOlzsYFxwt8meUSv2BwbaAoAGo_shOEM4WXeHCShcOqcpspS9l0RCH6z3_C1v2vtQnir7JLLVzv7qzNyZubXW02fDNUqiVF5VyloTbyHhulI-Op2Zt738pSCng3kztc7Mavdxa5wz1-HYfDyR_8eV_OyYtzf_AgAA__-Thnob) in waterborne tonnage, reaching 309.5 million tons in 2023. According to the Houston Port Authority, the port supports 3.37 million jobs nationwide and generates $906 billion annually. | Letter from the Chair
---
Over the past several years, Nebraska Republicans have achieved remarkable success: we now hold all five Congressional seats and every statewide office. These hard-fought victories are a testament to the strength of our shared conservative values and the dedication of Republicans across the state.
Yet success is never permanent--and complacency is our greatest threat. When Republicans stay home, Democrats win. History proves it. Our work is far from finished, and we cannot afford to let up now.
To secure Nebraska's future, we must grow our party and expand participation. That starts with inviting more Republicans to get involved at the grassroots level--especially by attending our 2026 county conventions. These gatherings are where ideas take shape, leaders emerge, and our movement strengthens.
The path to continued dominance is clear:
* Identify more Nebraskans who share our conservative principles
* Engage them in the political process
* Mobilize every Republican to vote in every election

Every day, we remain focused on our core mission: promoting our platform and electing candidates who will fight for it. That requires mastering the fundamentals:
1. Raise money to fuel our efforts
2. Communicate our conservative message clearly and consistently
3. Recruit, develop, organize, and elect strong Republican leaders

I urge you to join us in this vital work. Donate to the Nebraska Republican Party today and get more involved--whether by attending a county convention, volunteering, or helping spread our message. Together, we'll defend our principles and elect Republicans up and down the ballot.
The future of Nebraska depends on it. Let's get to work.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

| WHAT'S HAPPENING...
Candidate Recruitment Each week, I'm connecting with Nebraskans exploring public service, guiding committed candidates through next steps and equipping them with resources and tools, and partnering with community and party leaders, business owners, and elected officials to identify strong Republicans to run for offices up for election in 2026.
Recent highlights include two high-energy recruitment events in Lancaster and Douglas County, where attendees learned about seats up for election in 2026, candidate resources and tools provided to candidates by the NEGOP, and heard Senator Brad von Gillern share his journey into public office--resulting in several new candidate commitments.
The NEGOP Candidate Recruitment Committee has contacted over 300 Republican incumbents across federal, statewide, legislative, and multi-county offices to confirm re-election plans and is continuing to recruit challengers for Democrat-held seats. The enthusiasm is palpable--Nebraskans are ready to expand our majority.
We continue to host candidate trainings, like our upcoming Virtual Candidate Bootcamp series to equip potential candidates with the knowledge and confidence to run for office. These training sessions have also led to many new candidate commitments. Recruitment is a marathon and requires a multi-faceted approach, and we need your help. name: Jennifer Cunningham
subject: I want you to meet my husband Greg
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cunningham for NM
body:
His life has been defined by service, faith, and family

| | | Hello,

My name is Jennifer, and I’d like to introduce you to my husband, Greg Cunningham.

Greg is not a politician. He is a Marine Corps veteran, a retired Albuquerque Police detective, a small business owner, and most importantly — a proud husband, father, and grandfather.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlrt5l77kf7fm0lu6tnutsgfs7gfdnf3agd4nuog_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cjh61oj4cjh2bs)
---
From the time he was a teenager, Greg felt called to serve. That call took him to the United States Marine Corps, where he learned discipline, courage, and love of country. When his time in uniform ended, he came home to New Mexico and joined the Albuquerque Police Department — taking on cartels, gangs, and violent crime to keep families safe.

Greg never backed down from tough fights because he knew people’s lives depended on it. And that’s the same spirit he is bringing to this race for Congress.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zon7eeen8ka8o8mn7ient1tonmtrkpqdn86fhdn8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cjh61oj4cjh2bs)
---
Our family has deep roots in New Mexico, and we’ve seen firsthand how Washington’s failures hurt our neighbors:

**Open borders making our communities less safe.**
**Higher prices squeezing working families.**
**Radical policies that ignore the values we were raised with.**

Greg is running for Congress because New Mexicans deserve better. He’s ready to fight for our state the same way he’s fought his entire life - with courage, faith, and service to others.

I believe in Greg with all my heart. I know you will too.

**[Will you help him launch this campaign strong?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7p676tpjqu08f1egfc2pedbikmfe0ms5m4abfk0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cjh61oj4cjh2bs)**
---
[ **Become a Day 1 Supporter of Greg Cunningham** ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5et19kqjqtq3t691e04vqqqo98q2v324frn9nb0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cjh61oj4cjh2bs)
---
I can’t thank you enough for taking the time to get to know Greg and for believing in him the way that I do. With your support, I know he can carry our family’s values all the way to Congress.

---
Sincerely,
Jennifer Cunningham

If Trump’s plan is enforced, free speech is dead. But free speech and the right to protest are not gone yet. We’ve seen versions of this in America before: the Sedition Act of 1798 (expired) and the Sedition Act of 1918 (repealed). Each time, the men in power sought to quell opposition and silence those who questioned how government power was being used. And yet, the people eventually won. Because they wrote anyway. They spoke out anyway. They showed up anyway. We can’t be quiet about this. We have to call out their moves, push back, and defend our right to dissent before it disappears. Our strength lies in our numbers, and our success comes from our volume. But resistance takes all of us. Every voice. Every act of courage. Every small contribution keeps the fight alive. | Friends-
Halloween is finally here! We hope you're having a fun Halloween: maybe you're trick-or-treating with your family, hanging out with friends at home, or going out to see a spooky new movie. However you celebrate, we hope this Halloween is a fun ending to what has been an excellent October.
This month has been full of attention-grabbing headlines, but the news we're most excited about is that earlier this month, Colorado became the first state with a Prescription Drug Affordability Board to set an Upper Payment Limit (UPL) on Enbrel, a prescription drug used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, and other conditions. null – see that little girl in the photo? That’s me! Way before I had the honor of serving Michiganders in Congress and launching this battleground campaign to be Michigan’s next U.S. senator. I was about 12 or 13 years old there.
But don’t be fooled by school picture day (_and my trendy beaded necklace_). Growing up as the daughter of small-business owners – Mom and Dad had their own landscaping business – I was always around a lot of dirt, grease, grime, and heavy machinery. **I wouldn’t have had it any other way.**
My parents taught me the value of hard work – a value that binds all of us in Michigan together. After all, we’re the state that built America. The state that built the middle class.
In fact, do you know what one of my favorite memories is from growing up? When I got the keys to my first car, a used Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. That car represented the newfound freedom of teenage years. **But it was more to me than just that – it also meant I had a piece of Michigan.**
[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7806?t=4&akid=1237%2E49239%2EE9q2xj)
I love Michigan. I love the people here. And I love that I’ve been able to fight for my state in Congress. But as I’ve traveled our state recently, it’s clear that the people I love are afraid. They’re afraid because of the chaos and uncertainty that Donald Trump and the GOP are inflicting upon our nation.
All across our state, I hear concerns about rising costs, fear of uncertainty in our auto industry, and worries about the future of Social Security and Medicare. And you better believe people are outright disturbed by Trump’s attacks on our democracy and personal freedoms. **This fear, uncertainty, and chaos – all of it is**** _unacceptable._**
That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. I’m ready to fight for the people I love and help block Trump’s dangerous agenda. But the path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan – and this battleground race is being called a “Toss Up” by elections experts.

**This is one of the first major elections after the presidential election last fall.** In that election, Donald Trump was just 6 points away from winning right here in New Jersey — making it even more clear that New Jersey is no longer the safe blue state it once was.
**I’m showing our nation a new way forward.** My opponent has shown he’ll do anything Donald Trump tells him to — no matter how much it hurts New Jersey families. I will ALWAYS put the people of this state first, Peter. Leadership isn’t just following along with what some Washington politician wants. It’s doing what’s right for the people you serve, even when you get attacked for it.
**As New Jersey goes, so goes the nation.** What we do here in New Jersey will set the trend for 2026, 2028, and beyond. It’s up to us here to take a stand against Donald Trump’s incompetence and authoritarianism — and show the nation that there’s a better path forward.

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Before tonight?
body:
[ https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1001&akid=1935%2E791427%2Eu14aNy ][IMG]

We’re about to be 30 days into this government shutdown, and it’s important to remember why we’re here.

Trump and Republicans are set to cut funding that helps bring down the cost of health care plans under the Affordable Care Act. Democrats stepped up to defend Americans from skyrocketing premiums and millions losing their coverage. Republicans have spent 30 days refusing to negotiate or even consider finding a solution to this health care crisis that they created.

Let’s put those cuts in perspective. 24 million Americans are currently getting their health insurance through the ACA, and all are in danger of seeing hikes to their premiums come 2026.

One of those Americans is Jessica from Florida. The Wall Street Journal reports that her health insurance premiums will jump from around $200 a month to $1,100 a month if the Republicans’ planned cuts go through.

Those costs are so high that Jessica may just become one of the 4 million Americans that experts estimate will be forced off their ACA plans. That would be devastating, given that Jessica regularly sees a specialist for an eye condition and may in the future require surgery to avoid blindness.

This is how Republican cruelty forces Americans to choose between their own health and making rent.

And let’s not forget that Republicans already got away with a massive health care cut this year when they passed their Big Beautiful Bill. They stole almost a trillion dollars from Medicaid funds so they could pay for massive tax cuts for billionaires. Now over 11 million more Americans will lose their health care over the coming years, and costs will rise for millions more.

Charlie, Ilhan Omar understands that there is only one antidote to Trump and the GOP’s disastrous agenda on health care: Medicare-for-All.

It is outrageous that America is the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, but is also the only developed nation that does not provide health care as a human right.

Ilhan is committed to not only holding the line on opposing cuts to the ACA but also working every day to build the movement for Medicare-for-All and a future where Americans get the health care they deserve, no matter their income.

As this government shutdown drags past the 30-day mark, we understand that it’s a tough time for some. But if you can afford it, please chip in $10 or any amount to support Ilhan’s campaign to protect Americans from insanely high health care costs come 2026, and to finally pass Medicare-for-All and guarantee health care as a right for all people.

https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4629?t=1002&akid=1935%2E791427%2Eu14aNy

In solidarity,

Team Ilhan

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.ilhanomar.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1935%2E791427%2Eu14aNy

Peter,
The Virginia governor’s race is razor-thin, with RealClearPolitics showing just a **3% difference** between the candidates in the latest poll. That margin could be as high as **95,700 votes** or as low as **82,800**. The difference between godly leadership and policies that ignore biblical values.

With **5.81 million registered voters** in Virginia, turnout on **November 4** could range from **2.76 to 3.19 million** , depending on whether voters show up like they did in **2017 (47.6%)** or **2021 (54.9%)**. Will they be informed? Will they be guided by faith?

My Faith Votes is focused on reaching **low-propensity Christian voters**. Those who are already registered, but don’t vote consistently, especially in off-year elections like this one. Many simply need a reminder, a reason, and a resource to act. That’s where we come in.

Thanks to our army of Action Partners, we’re already sending over **112,000 letters** to low-propensity Christian voters in Virginia and more are being written every day.

_But we must do more._

**Text messaging has been proven to boost turnout.** We want to follow up with those receiving letters and reach even more Christian voters across Virginia with a simple, powerful message and a link to our **Candidate Fact Sheet.**

name: Leslie Mehta
subject: Virginia’s future hangs in the ballot
disclaimer_text:
Paid For By
Leslie Mehta for Delegate
body:
Hi Peter,

Tomorrow is the last day for early voting in Virginia.

I know it's Halloween and you have things to do. But please take ten minutes out of your day to vote if you can.

When you think of elections, you might imagine national headlines. But right now, it’s Virginia, and your vote, that will have a lasting impact.

Federal policy is uncertain at best right now, leaving the states as the last line of defense for Americans everywhere. Virginia’s legislature will determine how much protection you will have from the fallout of the current Administration.

Here are three big reasons this election is so critical:

1. Healthcare hangs in the balance.

Hospitals are facing staffing shortages and closures. Clinics are under strain. Federal health programs are in flux. Virginia’s lawmakers will decide how our state responds to rising medical costs, and how much of that expense falls on every taxpayer.

Virginia’s upcoming election includes every seat in the House of Delegates—so the majority will control health policy for years.

2. The cost of living is hitting families.

From housing to utilities to jobs, Virginians feel the squeeze. State leadership will determine whether everyday working families gain or lose ground.

3. Reproductive rights and personal freedoms are at stake.

The choices women make, the protections families rely on, and the access to medical care are being debated. The state legislature and governor’s office are the front lines for these decisions.
Your decision this November is more than just which individual candidate wins. It’s which direction Virginia goes on healthcare, economic opportunity, rights, and fairness.
Your vote counts. So make your voice heard, if not today, then on November 4. You can find information on Chesterfield polling places and hours here. [https://www.chesterfield.gov/registrar]

Thank you for taking the time to vote!

Leslie

Patriot, it's Pat Harrigan.

Today's a special day for me, and no, it's not my anniversary or anything related to my service as a Green Beret.

It's the day I finally got a few minutes to sit down at my desk and write you the email I've been thinking about for weeks.

Let me preface this by saying I've never been afraid to ask for help. After you spend two tours in Afghanistan carrying hundreds of pounds of equipment and moving mountains to get the job done, there are some things you tell yourself, "No, I can't ask anyone for help with this; I need to do it myself."

That line of thinking has led me to this unfortunate circumstance I find myself in.

When my team told me they needed my help with fundraising, I reassured them not to worry and that I'd take care of it.

I messed up.

clean_body: | Patriot, it's Pat Harrigan. Today's a special day for me, and no, it's not my anniversary or anything related to my service as a Green Beret. It's the day I finally got a few minutes to sit down at my desk and write you the email I've been thinking about for weeks. Let me preface this by saying I've never been afraid to ask for help. After you spend two tours in Afghanistan carrying hundreds of pounds of equipment and moving mountains to get the job done, there are some things you tell yourself, "No, I can't ask anyone for help with this; I need to do it myself." That line of thinking has led me to this unfortunate circumstance I find myself in. When my team told me they needed my help with fundraising, I reassured them not to worry and that I'd take care of it. I messed up. Asking people for money is a hard thing to do, and I couldn't bring myself to do it over the past few weeks. Now I 'm way behind where I need to be ahead of tonight's midnight deadline. Thank you, Pat Harrigan | Paid for by The Pat Harrigan Committee PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624 Copyright (C) 2025 Pat Harrigan for Congress, All rights reserved.

name: Lizzie Fletcher
subject: What a month.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Every day this month has provided a new illustration of the dysfunction and destruction in Washington—and another reminder of why we must win back the House in 2026 and so much more.
There is perhaps no greater visual representation of this than this one:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folfe251030?refcode=folfe251030 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folfe251030?refcode=folfe251030]
(Jacquelyn Martin, AP)
The unannounced, unauthorized, and unprecedented destruction of the East Wing of White House is a symbol of so much more—the purposeful dismantling and destruction of our government, with no opposition from the people in charge in Congress.
A Month Without Government Funding
We are now on day 31 of the government shutdown. The House has not met since September 19. House Speaker Mike Johnson sees no reason for the House to convene in Washington—not to address the health care crisis Congressional Republicans and the Trump administration have brought on, not to swear in a new Democratic member of Congress, not to negotiate the funding bills for the next year. Instead, he sent his members on vacation.
Congress’ inaction has real consequences. Critical federal services are grinding to a halt. Civil servants—from air traffic controllers to food safety workers are working without pay. Public servants have been working without pay for nearly a month. Military families and federal workers are going to food pantries. And now, the Trump administration is using hunger as a weapon—cutting off funding for food assistance for Americans who need it: 42 million people. There is $5 billion in an emergency fund for this purpose sitting at the USDA that the Trump administration refuses to use to help. Many states are fighting back by suing the administration. I am sorry to say Texas is not one of them.
Texas National Guard Deployment
At the same time, the Trump administration is showing up in places where it is not needed or wanted, sending the National Guard to blue cities and blue states for no legitimate purpose. And Governor Greg Abbott is enabling this abuse of power, sending 200 members of the Texas National Guard to Chicago. Earlier this month, I called on Governor Abbott to bring our service members home and put Texans first with other members of Texas’ Democratic congressional delegation.
The Fight for Fair Maps in Texas
But Governor Abbott has made clear this year that his priority is not serving Texans but serving President Trump. This month, a panel of federal judges concluded a ten-day hearing on the new congressional map that President Trump ordered and Governor Abbott supplied—a map that intentionally dilutes the voting power of minority Texans. The judges will soon decide whether it will stop that map from going into effect in 2026. Thank you to all the #TeamLizzie supporters and volunteers who have supported the fight for fair representation in Texas. The fight continues, and I’ll keep working to ensure that every Texan’s voice and vote count equally.
Looking Ahead
November brings important opportunities to fight back. Next week, voters here at home and across the country will cast their ballots in an important referendum. Here in Houston, we can elect a new member to Congress to fill a vacancy in the storied 18th Congressional District that Governor Abbott has shamefully and purposefully delayed and vote on several other important matters and positions. In Virginia and New Jersey, voters have the opportunity to elect new governors that will fight back against the Trump administration, and voters across the country can reject the redistricting efforts underway in states across the country. And several cases challenging the Administration’s continued unlawful actions will be heard in court.
In November, our team will continue the work we have been doing in October, and since the very first day we started. Thanks to all the volunteers who helped do that work this month—from phone banks for California’s proposition 50, Mikie Sherrill, and Abigail Spanberger to those who sent a contribution or a supportive note of encouragement. We need all of those things now, and we will until next November and beyond.
The fight is real and it is here. Your support makes it possible for us to keep fighting and building the strength we’ll need to win in 2026 and beyond.
If you’re in a position to do so, I hope you will consider making a contribution to support this campaign—it is an investment in fairness, justice, and democracy in Texas and across the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folfe251030?refcode=folfe251030]
Together we can do anything,

The entire country is watching this race

| Peter, there are a couple of reasons why the entire country is watching this race:

**This is one of the first major elections after the presidential election last fall.** In that election, Donald Trump was just 6 points away from winning right here in New Jersey — making it even more clear that New Jersey is no longer the safe blue state it once was.

**I’m showing our nation a new way forward.** My opponent has shown he’ll do anything Donald Trump tells him to — no matter how much it hurts New Jersey families. I will ALWAYS put the people of this state first, Peter. Leadership isn’t just following along with what some Washington politician wants. It’s doing what’s right for the people you serve, even when you get attacked for it.

**As New Jersey goes, so goes the nation.** What we do here in New Jersey will set the trend for 2026, 2028, and beyond. It’s up to us here to take a stand against Donald Trump’s incompetence and authoritarianism — and show the nation that there’s a better path forward.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

name: Gary Miller for House of Delegates
subject: "Hope is a discipline" - A lesson from a 102-year-old Virginian
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GARY MILLER FOR DELEGATE** 121 Bell Ct
body:
In the final days of a long campaign, it’s easy to feel cynical.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4baa6c6cb62a/hope-is-a-discipline-a-lesson-from-a-102-year-old-virginian?e=606d7e9aa2)
---
[|
---](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=a5133c5975&e=606d7e9aa2)
| | | | |
---
| |

Friend,
In the final days of a long campaign, it’s easy to feel cynical. It's easy to believe the noise that says your voice doesn't matter, that the system is rigged, and that nothing will ever really change.
**Hope is the discipline of showing up** , even when you're tired.It is the discipline of believing in common sense, even when it's unpopular, and it is the discipline of casting a vote, even when the outcome isn't guaranteed.
[This is Ms. **Edith Edmunds of Halifax**. She is 102 years old. She is a quilting master, a community elder, and a true Virginia treasure.](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=dffee97262&e=606d7e9aa2)
She has also voted in **every single election since 1948.**
I had the profound honor of sitting with her, and I asked her why. Why, for over 75 years, has she never missed one?
Her answer must be heard across the Commonwealth.
[**"I vote to let them know that I'm human. And I can think just like you... Whether the person I voted for wins or not, I vote."**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=1277f6406e&e=606d7e9aa2)
This is the very definition of disciplined hope.
It is the act of showing up, not because victory is certain, but because participation is essential. It's the profound understanding that our humanity and our voice are linked, and that **we must exercise that voice to affirm our place in our community**.
This is the Virginia I am fighting for.
I am not running on cynicism. I am running on the common-sense belief that we, the people, can still solve our own problems.
We can lower your electric bills by **breaking up the monopolies** , and we can create **new paths to the middle class** by investing in skilled trades and technical education. We must restore common sense to Richmond.
[None of it is possible without that same discipline Ms. Edmunds has shown us.](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=54b50d7709&e=606d7e9aa2)
We are **4 days away** from Election Day. This is our moment to choose action over apathy. This is our time to practice the discipline of hope.
**Please, make your plan to vote on Tuesday, November 4th.**
Vote for common sense. Vote to honor the legacy of voters like Ms. Edmunds. **Vote to let them know that** _**you**_**are here.**
Thank you for your support,
Dr. Gary MillerDemocratic Nominee House of Delegates - 49

**Today is Halloween, and here’s what *really* scares our team:**
* **🎃 Allowing dark money groups to buy this Senate seat:** Right-wing Super PACs and MAGA dark money groups are already pouring millions of dollars into Georgia to try to flip Jon’s seat red. Donations to emails like this one are one of the top ways we fight back.

**👻 Locking in a Republican Senate majority for the long run:** Republicans know flipping Jon’s seat not only guarantees them the Senate majority, but locks it in for the long run. With that power, Trump’s last constraints in the Senate vanish. What’s left is total submission. No oversight. No guardrails when he comes for the rule of law.

**🦇 Watching a MAGA extremist take the oath of office:** What we do between now and next November will be our best chance to stop one of Jon’s extreme right-wing opponents from taking his seat and becoming another rubber stamp on the Trump agenda.

Rep. Joe Sweeney

body:
Unless the email is from PA Supreme Court Justices Wecht, Dougherty, or Donohue, that fundraising email is not as important or as urgent as what we are sending you right now.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001VPJQYIY3ZwVCL15HyxhYeKRI-g3CMdt2q98wKFYFhkk2h9hVtEmJtkY26W5WwMj8q07jXcsx9tRwqQHB_vXa4CWn1TC6sorygzD66Unr6SaNG4B_rrH06qiNEdYuRs2JZWY19zq_5kp6U4avsrOTnH-GSxEIZsrI0yA3GAAptZmDDzjtmKw1Fow6jM5lFdoyzUAXhcAP1RjxGGBmJ_weaXr4hP7TimnYIjzw93nlKCs=&c=BOTTG-aZpyKoxBqq57t5VGAiXN4bcwIHw9b9TvnQYLoI3hma7_PXwQ==&ch=0xvGFE2mhopfUVcr8b3hcdn9BbwLgx-YfhjiNPvVZ9fM52qhDyyfJg==)

|
Peter,
Today you will likely receive dozens of solicitations from Democrats across the country asking for your support to help them finish October as strongly as possible.
Unless the email is from PA Supreme Court Justices Wecht, Dougherty, or Donohue, that fundraising email is not as important or as urgent as what we are sending you right now. We are not being facetious when we say this. Here's why:
In less than 4 days, November 4th 2025, Pennsylvanians will vote in a state Supreme Court Election that is life or death for Democrats across the nation. This body has the final say on key swing state Pennsylvania's voter suppression laws and on election results.
If MAGA takes this court it means Pennsylvania and its 19 electoral college votes will never go for Dems again. Not in the '26 midterms and not in the '28 presidential election where Trump claims he'll seek a third term.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001VPJQYIY3ZwVCL15HyxhYeKRI-g3CMdt2q98wKFYFhkk2h9hVtEmJtkY26W5WwMj8q07jXcsx9tRwqQHB_vXa4CWn1TC6sorygzD66Unr6SaNG4B_rrH06qiNEdYuRs2JZWY19zq_5kp6U4avsrOTnH-GSxEIZsrI0yA3GAAptZmDDzjtmKw1Fow6jM5lFdoyzUAXhcAP1RjxGGBmJ_weaRmZHUEgN3Vx5kNy_jN72YM=&c=BOTTG-aZpyKoxBqq57t5VGAiXN4bcwIHw9b9TvnQYLoI3hma7_PXwQ==&ch=0xvGFE2mhopfUVcr8b3hcdn9BbwLgx-YfhjiNPvVZ9fM52qhDyyfJg==)
---
| The above headline mentions that these justices rarely lose in retention elections and this was the prevailing notion that Democrats had coming into this race. It made us complacent and until just weeks ago everyone thought a Democratic win was assured.
Now we are in the midst of a full blown frontal assault as MAGA has taken the lead in this race and is throwing everything they have into seizing this critical court.
Democrats are mounting a comeback in this race and Defend Our Courts is leading the counteroffensive but we are still massively outnumbered and outgunned.
In Spring 2025 Democrats faced a similar onslaught in the Wisconsin Supreme Court Election and were able to pull off a stunning victory, however, that was early on in the year before most congressional campaigns had kicked off their fundraising. | | | | | | Friend,
Democrats in the Senate have kept the government shut down for weeks, and the effects are starting to have a real impact. In a few weeks, our nation’s servicemembers will be working without pay, and our veterans’ benefits will run dry. **Our nation’s heroes should never be treated as pawns in a political game!**
Democrats run campaigns on protecting our nation’s veterans and supporting active-duty servicemembers, and they even went after President Trump relentlessly, claiming he does not respect our nation’s military. Remember that Fake News story about President Trump disrespecting fallen Americans at a military cemetery? Well now America can see them for who they really are. **Democrats are willing to let our servicemembers go without pay and struggle to feed their families** , while gaslighting Republicans and blaming them for the shutdown.
President Trump has been hard at work to try to keep our servicemembers from losing their paychecks, military readiness from being impacted, and from veterans losing access to benefits they earned. **The longer this shutdown lasts, the worse the effects on readiness will get. From financial stress impacting our servicemembers, to delays on military technology and lapses in critical training, the problems extend beyond servicemembers’ pay.** A very generous donor has come forward and offered to help continue supporting our military personnel. Still, the reality is that the only way to ensure our heroes are paid consistently is to end **this cynical shutdown.**
In Arizona, as a veteran, I have consistently fought for our nation’s veterans and those who serve in uniform. **I will do the same in Congress.** The voters of Arizona’s 5th Congressional District deserve a representative who will fight for our veterans and servicemembers in Washington!

body:
Must-See Legislation Updates

| | | [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=1)
---
---
##### TAKE ACTION
# Track, Advocate & Influence Policy
Stay informed on key legislation related to MAHA’s mission at the state and federal levels. View our Legislative Tracker to learn how you can take action in your state.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/lawmakers?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=2 "SEE LEGISLATIVE TRACKER") [SEE LEGISLATIVE TRACKER](https://www.mahaaction.com/lawmakers?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=2)
---
---
## **Must-See Updates Below👇**
---
---
### Federal HR1864 – Risky Research Review Act
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Proposed by Rep. Griffith on March 5, 2025, the bill establishes a nine-member Life Sciences Research Security Board to regulate and fund risky research, requiring reporting, oversight, and safety compliance, funded with $30 million annually through 2035.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s creation of an oversight board ensures risky life sciences research is thoroughly reviewed, supporting MAHA’s goal of protecting public health through transparent and accountable science.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1855237&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=3 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1855237&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=3)
---
---
---
### Federal HR4388 – PREP Repeal Act
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Introduced by Rep. Massie on July 15, 2025, the bill repeals PREP Act liability protections for drugmakers, allowing lawsuits for vaccine or drug injuries, ending unused compensation funds, and preserving valid sections if parts are overturned.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s repeal of pharmaceutical liability shields strengthens accountability, aligning with MAHA’s fight for a transparent healthcare system that prioritizes patient safety and trust.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1901447&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=4 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1901447&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=4)
---
---
---
### Fedral HR119 – Prohibit COVID Vaccine Requirements for Employees
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Introduced by Rep. Andy Biggs on January 3, 2025, the bill bars organizations that took COVID-19 relief funds from mandating employee vaccinations, requiring repayment of funds if they do. It seeks to protect worker choice and employer autonomy in vaccine policies.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s prohibition on COVID-19 vaccine mandates for federally funded entities upholds individual health autonomy, a cornerstone of MAHA’s mission to empower people in their healthcare decisions.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1764947&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=5 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1764947&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=5)
---
---
---
### North Carolina H874 – North Carolina Healthy Schools Act
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Introduced by Rep. Almond on April 10, 2025, North Carolina House Bill 874 bans ultra-processed foods in public schools starting in 2025–2026, requiring compliance certification to promote healthier, minimally processed meals and combat childhood obesity.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s ban on ultra-processed foods in schools promotes healthier eating habits for kids, directly supporting MAHA’s mission to combat obesity and foster nutrient-rich diets.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1884058&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=6 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1884058&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=6)
---
---
---
### Wisconsin SB228 – Protecting School Meals from Harmful Additives
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Introduced by Sen. Cabral-Guevara in 2025, Wisconsin Senate Bill 228 bans school meal programs from serving foods with harmful additives like brominated vegetable oil or red dye 3 starting July 1, 2027, aiming to improve meal safety while allowing private vendor sales.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s ban on harmful ingredients in school meals ensures kids get safer, healthier food, advancing MAHA’s mission to promote nutrition-focused solutions for better health.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1889104&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=7 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1889104&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=7)
---
---
---
### Georgia SB366 – Ivermectin's Status as a Controlled Substances
### MAHA's Position: 👍 Vote yes!
**Bill Summary:** Introduced by Sen. Jason Anavitarte on March 28, 2025, the Georgia bill allows over-the-counter sales of ivermectin by removing it from the state’s controlled substances list, expanding access for human use by authorizing pharmacists to sell it without a prescription.
---
**Why This Matters:** This bill’s deregulation of ivermectin empowers Georgians to access a versatile treatment, supporting MAHA’s mission to promote health freedom and affordable healthcare options.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1878174&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=8 "TAKE ACTION") [TAKE ACTION](https://www.mahaaction.com/bill-details?id=1878174&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legislative_emails_251030_segm&n=8)
---
---
---

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Someone was living in her attic 🎃
body:
For months. Eating KFC. Listening to everything. This actually happened.

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d3dd9a386d&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
Happy Halloween!

This week we're sharing two [TRUE stories](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=642a1a0610&e=567664f14c) from our lives - one unexplained, one terrifying.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=89bd894021&e=567664f14c)
| |
🏨 **THE STANLEY HOTEL MYSTERY**
We stayed on the fourth floor (most haunted). At 2 AM, Mark heard thunderous footsteps running past our room. Nothing in the hallway.
Next morning at checkout, the elevator doors opened. Krysty's distinctive flip-flops were lying in the middle of the floor - the ones buried at the bottom of her packed bag that she never took out.
Hotel staff: "Weird things happen here."
No explanation.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=642c08d935&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
😱 **THE COLLEGE NIGHTMARE**
Krysty's telling this complete story for the first time.
1992, Colorado State, sophomore year. It started with a strange phone call. Then lights turning on when no one was home. Phone ringing EXACTLY when they walked in - every single time.
Someone rifled through dresser drawers. Police didn't take it seriously.
Then they came home one night. Walked through the dark house. Heard a door slam. Kitchen door to garage was open. Bathroom had been used.
**He was inside while they were there.**
Months of this. Motion lights. Her brother camping in the backyard with a shotgun. Her mom secretly tapping the phone (traced to a cell phone - rare and expensive in 1992).
Final discovery: Police found a ladder to the attic. Went up. Found fresh KFC boxes and beer cans.
**Someone had been living above them the entire time.**
Cops: "Leave today. This is the creepiest thing we've ever seen."
The person was never caught.
Five years later, it happened again when she was a news anchor in Grand Junction. This time she handled it differently.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d3f04a9213&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🎃 **WHICH IS SCARIER?**
Unexplained phenomena at a haunted hotel? Or someone living above you for months, listening to everything, never getting caught?

Democrats can’t flip the Senate without winning New Hampshire. That’s why we have to rally around Chris right now.
#
Peter, we have a problem.
A top election analyst just downgraded our chances of winning the U.S. Senate race in New Hampshire after former Sen. John Sununu announced his comeback bid.
Let us be absolutely clear: **If Chris Pappas loses in New Hampshire, Democrats have _no_ viable path to flipping the Senate.**
We can’t afford to fall behind in this moment. **[That’s why we’re asking you to support Chris and State Democrats Committee with a donation today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/97268?refcode=em20251031-9657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9657%2E614464%2Ev7igmm)**
With Senator Shaheen retiring, this seat is wide open and extremely vulnerable.
And with Sununu in the race, Republicans just got a huge boost in their efforts to flip this seat and keep the Senate majority.
John Sununu isn’t just any Republican. He’s backed by the entire Washington establishment. He comes from a political dynasty, has national name recognition, and brings a fundraising machine fueled by Wall Street and corporate special interests.
**Chris Pappas is the Democrat who can win this race.** He’s a proven public servant who’s won his purple Congressional district in New Hampshire four times. But this race just got more expensive, more competitive, and more dangerous for Democrats. That’s why we’re asking:

Far-right billionaires and special interests are already flooding New Hampshire with cash to flip this seat red.
If Democrats lose here, we lose the Senate. It’s that simple. We must hold this seat by electing Chris Pappas to keep our chances of flipping Senate control alive. And that only happens if we help him build the grassroots support he’ll need to overcome the money pouring into New Hampshire.

Hi Friend,
Welcome to the latest New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) newsletter!
Earlier this week, the PA [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] House State Government Committee [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] voted on two bills that have the potential to impact our voting rights: State Rep Mehaffie's Voter ID bill (HB771) and State Rep. McClinton's omnibus bill (HB1396). Both passed out of committee this week and will now be voted on by the full house.
An omnibus bill is a legislative bill that combines multiple, sometimes unrelated, provisions or bills into one single bill. It's essentially a package deal of different legislative proposals, often used to facilitate the passage of legislation, particularly appropriations bills.
HB 771 is sponsored by State Rep. Thomas Mehaffie (Dauphin) and “would require all voters arriving at their election precincts to show identification or attest under penalty of law that they are legally able to vote in Pennsylvania.”
State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta (Philadelphia) voiced his opposition to the bill. The bill doesn’t address [https://www.politicspa.com/state-government-committee-sends-voter-id-election-omnibus-bills-to-house-floor/141399] the real issues at stake. “We need to solve problems of voter irregularities and voter fraud,” he said. “We do not have demonstrable evidence that leads us to make the point that we need to address voter ID in this way. Let’s talk about the issues that do exist. This legislation doesn’t address those.”
HB 1396 has a more recognizable name behind it – Speaker of the State House Joanna McClinton (Delaware/Philadelphia). State Rep. Ben Waxman (Philadelphia) complemented the Speaker, saying that the legislation is a “comprehensive approach to election reform that tries to dramatically improve the process and makes administration of elections much smoother.”
Among other changes, [https://penncapital-star.com/campaigns-elections/voter-id-and-vote-by-mail-reform-bills-move-to-pa-house] House Bill 1396 would also give election workers up to a week before Election Day to prepare to count mail-in ballots, a process that has been a bottleneck for election results in parts of the state, providing fodder for election deniers.
The vote-by-mail provision has been the subject of numerous lawsuits, including one now before the U.S. Supreme Court, as candidates and parties have argued over how election officials should handle irregularities, such as errors on completed ballots, that are not explicitly addressed.
The bill would make clear that county election officials are required to notify voters if their mail-in ballots have been rejected for the lack of a signature and give the voter an opportunity to “cure” the error.
Upcoming events
As Allegheny County voters prepare for the pivotal 2025 local, municipal and judicial elections, the New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) is hosting two critical public candidate forums to give community members the chance to hear directly from the candidates shaping our schools and courts. These moderated discussions will allow voters to ask questions and learn more about each candidate’s priorities and qualifications before heading to the polls.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Pittsburgh%20School%20board%20forum%208.5x11.png]
Meet the candidates running for the Pittsburgh School Board and hear how they plan to impact our schools and students.
Moderator: Dr. Kimeka Campbell is our Senior Director of Campaigns and Engagement. She is a recognized community activist, political strategist, and civic engagement leader.
With over 15 years of experience in community organizing, political consulting, and nonprofit leadership, Dr. Campbell has been instrumental in shaping voter engagement strategies and building coalitions for progressive change. She co-founded Young Professionals of Color–Greater Harrisburg (YPOC), an organization dedicated to fostering leadership, advocacy, and professional growth for communities of color.

Get to know the Allegheny County Common Pleas judicial candidates before you cast your ballot.
Your vote shapes our justice system!
Moderator: Rachel Bracken, Alliance for Justice (AFJ), Senior Regional State Courts Manager
Rachel is a Senior Regional State Courts Manager with Alliance for Justice/AFJ Action. In this position, she manages AFJ/AFJ Action’s involvement in state supreme court justice elections and selection processes. Prior to joining the Justice Team, Rachel was on AFJ’s Outreach Team where she helped create AFJ’s State Court Justice Project and launch AFJ Action’s State Courts Matter initiative. She also coordinated AFJ’s networks of law professors, attorneys, and political donors to advocate around federal judicial nominations and federal courts’ impact on our constitutional rights and freedoms.
