body:
Please - for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please - for the sake of all our families - take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue 's Clues_...
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkc2umzAQhZ_G7BzhsTFkwSK5hChSU1VZUHVl-WdIrIKNwHDVt6-omge4u9HRNyN9c37e1V37wYfndz1ibTev5kUtKU6vOAx_PmN0_RzHGbV9-fBUkENBWU452zmWudo6ySHDmpWSHTmUvMpedS9YzwwyzZiurHG2Mlihs0fIORx7kfl6v8RyzlgpCi4PBsrCiMLYUhsrLRCRr5PTCZeDjWHBedPJb-hDiPsUw8HGMRvqV0rTQviJQEugXdCuMx50QBfTThBozaw3pCbG3wuBFkpWgIWKugIlFUYIWjFZUSxMKSWWfXVkhLdrGtUS19ki4c25udLHpSMg93hE59eR8OZy_59YPU7aPwPhzW6VC5arc3NV58epu6jb9foLim_qcenUjxP96G7vtRgShkR489Hd6Psf2Vy76dMPg19kSUT-HLUf_smmr9ez1fA3AAD__7yMmVM)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses. And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children's television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkc2umzAQhZ_G7BzhsTFkwSK5hChSU1VZUHVl-WdIrIKNwHDVt6-omge4u9HRNyN9c37e1V37wYfndz1ibTev5kUtKU6vOAx_PmN0_RzHGbV9-fBUkENBWU452zmWudo6ySHDmpWSHTmUvMpedS9YzwwyzZiurHG2Mlihs0fIORx7kfl6v8RyzlgpCi4PBsrCiMLYUhsrLRCRr5PTCZeDjWHBedPJb-hDiPsUw8HGMRvqV0rTQviJQEugXdCuMx50QBfTThBozaw3pCbG3wuBFkpWgIWKugIlFUYIWjFZUSxMKSWWfXVkhLdrGtUS19ki4c25udLHpSMg93hE59eR8OZy_59YPU7aPwPhzW6VC5arc3NV58epu6jb9foLim_qcenUjxP96G7vtRgShkR489Hd6Psf2Vy76dMPg19kSUT-HLUf_smmr9ez1fA3AAD__7yMmVM)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**. If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own. And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries. It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. >> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces. And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages. It was quite a moment for everyone - including folks just like you - who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we've made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging. But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. clean_body: My intention is never to be a nuisance, but the truth of the matter is, things have slowed down substantially this month | Fellow Conservative, Will Virginia elect a Republican governor? Will New Jersey elect a Democrat for the third straight term? Will New York City elect its first socialist? We’ll know on Tuesday. Regardless of what happens, you need to know that we’re doing our best to bring the fight to the Democrat Party here in Minnesota, a state that Republicans wrote off for a very long time - but no more. Despite a recent poll from one of my opponents showing a Republican coming within two points of flipping one of Minnesota’s two Senate seats next year , our Fundraising has all but dried up this month. Month over month, we’re down 58%. You never know if you don’t ask, so please consider this humble request before you log off your devices for the evening. For a better tomorrow, Adam Schwarze Retired Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota Former Navy SEAL officer Marine Corps Veteran Proud Minnesotan P.S: The Democrat machine will pour tens of millions into Minnesota to try to crush this campaign before most voters even hear my name. They want a senator who will rubber-stamp their agenda. I’m not that man — and that’s why they’ll do whatever it takes to stop me. The Working Families Party’s Neighborhood Captains program has mobilized Detroiters to encourage their neighbors to vote.
In addition to knocking on doors and making phone calls, these captains have hosted neighborhood events to discuss issues and build relationships with their neighbors. This is an important step toward long-term community-based relational organizing that regularly engages voters in issues that impact them.
Denzel has led campaigns for justice and equity, voting rights and campaign finance reform, and responsive governments that co-govern with constituents. **He is running against a State Representative who has voted with Republicans against paid family leave, against raising the minimum wage, and against public school funding** —while failing to protect reproductive rights.
**Detroit is one of the poorest cities in the country, so its residents deserve elected leaders who serve the working class.** Denzel and Gaby are running for Detroit City Council to make housing and healthcare affordable, protect immigrants and other vulnerable residents, hold corporate polluters accountable, and push for a budget that centers community investment.
Gaby, who’s running for re-election, hit the ground running in her first term on the council. **She secured funding to keep Detroiters in their homes and to support first-time homeowners, passed a policy to protect Detroiters from industrial pollution** , and created a successful Community Violence Intervention program. She’s also offering “know your rights” trainings for immigrants and championing policy to limit local police cooperation with ICE.
**Right now, we need a surge of grassroots funding to help Gaby and Denzel overcome corporate PAC spending and win on Tuesday—Election Day.**

clean_body: We’re fighting for a government that serves the people rather than corporations or billionaires. | | | Friend, With less than 5 days until Election Day, we need all hands on deck to elect the only Michigan candidates endorsed by the progressive Working Families Party: Gabriela Santiago-Romero and Denzel McCampbell. The Michigan Working Families Party is getting out the vote for these bold change-makers who will serve the people rather than corporations. Both members of the Democratic Socialists of America, Denzel and Gaby are running against corporate Democrats. Here’s part of their flyer for Get Out the Vote events for Gaby and Denzel: | The Working Families Party’s Neighborhood Captains program has mobilized Detroiters to encourage their neighbors to vote. In addition to knocking on doors and making phone calls, these captains have hosted neighborhood events to discuss issues and build relationships with their neighbors. This is an important step toward long-term community-based relational organizing that regularly engages voters in issues that impact them. Denzel has led campaigns for justice and equity, voting rights and campaign finance reform, and responsive governments that co-govern with constituents. He is running against a State Representative who has voted with Republicans against paid family leave, against raising the minimum wage, and against public school funding —while failing to protect reproductive rights. Detroit is one of the poorest cities in the country, so its residents deserve elected leaders who serve the working class. Denzel and Gaby are running for Detroit City Council to make housing and healthcare affordable, protect immigrants and other vulnerable residents, hold corporate polluters accountable, and push for a budget that centers community investment. Gaby, who’s running for re-election, hit the ground running in her first term on the council. She secured funding to keep Detroiters in their homes and to support first-time homeowners, passed a policy to protect Detroiters from industrial pollution , and created a successful Community Violence Intervention program. She’s also offering “know your rights” trainings for immigrants and championing policy to limit local police cooperation with ICE. Right now, we need a surge of grassroots funding to help Gaby and Denzel overcome corporate PAC spending and win on Tuesday—Election Day. clean_body: We don’t want to look back the day after Election Day and wish we’d done more. | The truth is, our fundraising isn't where it should be at this point in the month. And with voters already casting their ballots in states like Virginia and Pennsylvania, we’re trying something new. We've set an ambitious $50,000 fundraising goal to hit by midnight, and we're asking our most dedicated supporters to chip in just $5 to help us catch up. = It might not sound like much, but grassroots donations of $5 — not Big Oil’s billionaire checks — are how we’ve built everything we’ve accomplished. ✅ It’s how we helped elect nearly 100 climate leaders in high-stakes races across the country in 2024. 🏆 It’s how we’ve racked up seven big wins so far in high-stakes races this year. 🔥 And it’s how we’re going to keep building local and state-level power in a moment where our national politics are barreling toward authoritarianism. If you've ever wondered if a single dollar can make a difference, here's your answer: Yes. It already has. And with just 4 days left until Election Day, your support will make a difference for dozens of our endorsed climate champions facing some of the most competitive races around the country in 2025. Because it's not just your $5 donation. It's $5 from thousands of people just like you who truly understand the state of our country and are motivated to be a part of the solution. = | = = The next 4 days will decide more than an election. They’ll decide what kind of future we fight for. Thank you for all you’ve done for JanePAC. | We can organize, mobilize, and reclaim our country.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9145%2E5257348%2Ed4o2ht)
I’ll be honest — **[I am reaching out to ask you to make a donation to my campaign. I promise there is a good reason, and after you donate, I hope you’ll keep reading to find out more.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q42025_abs_em.dd-KUe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20251031_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9145%2E5257348%2Ed4o2ht)**
We have an end-of-month deadline coming up tonight, and there is so much at stake right now.
Here are just _ten_ things that Trump is doing that are making our country less democratic, less safe, and less affordable:
**1\. Undermining trust in science and medicine:**
Trump is defunding our world-class scientific research institutions, shutting out international talent, and spreading misinformation about vaccines and the safety of medicine like Tylenol.
**2\. Slashing food assistance:**
He’s gutting the supplemental nutrition programs that keep millions of American families healthy and ensure our kids don’t go to bed hungry.
**3\. Abandoning our allies:**
Trump is weakening our international partnerships, cozying up with dictators, and making America less safe.
**4\. Sabotaging renewable energy:**
He’s killing clean energy projects, ceding global renewable energy leadership to China, raising utility bills, and making us more dependent on fossil fuels.
**5\. Damaging public health:**
He’s slashing funding for the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and key research programs, meaning cures will be delayed, clinical trials will end, and life-saving care will be harder to access.
**6\. Firing federal workers:**
The Trump administration has already fired over 50,000 federal workers in the first nine months of this administration, and pushed out over 200,000 federal workers in total.
**7\. Tanking the economy with tariffs:**
His trade wars are driving up the costs of everyday goods like clothes and groceries while alienating our allies.
**8\. Stripping away healthcare:**
Under Trump’s new budget, millions of Americans will lose healthcare coverage. Many rural clinics and hospitals will be forced to close, and all of our healthcare costs will go up.
**9\. Undermining the rule of law:**
Trump has been treating the Department of Justice as his own personal political weapon, using it to shield his allies and target his enemies.
**10\. Threatening our freedom of speech:**
Trump wants to decide who gets to speak their mind in this country and who gets punished for exercising their constitutional right to free speech.
So like I said, there is a _lot_ at stake these days — but I believe that together, we can take back our government and end this madness.
The GOP wants to overwhelm us and keep us from acting. But when we come together, we’re not powerless. We can organize, mobilize, and reclaim our country.
**[If you’re with me, please make a contribution before our October fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q42025_abs_em.dd-KUe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20251031_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=9145%2E5257348%2Ed4o2ht)**
Thanks for stepping up,
Adam

I’m hitting the road to help our candidates win next Tuesday — but I need your help before midnight.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20251031-1&t=1&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)
Hey Peter,
I’m hitting the road this weekend and visiting three states — Texas, Georgia, and New York — to support some of the most inspiring young leaders on the ballot next Tuesday.
As we help push our candidates into the final stretch of their campaigns, Leaders We Deserve is also facing our end-of-month deadline tonight. We’re falling short, but with your help, we can close the gap. We’ve come too far and built too much momentum to drop the ball in the last few hours.
**[So I’m asking — could you please give just $3 to help us win these three races next week, power the next generation of leaders, and hit tonight’s goal?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&refcode=em20251031-2791&amount=3&t=3&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)**
**[Donate $3 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&amount=3&refcode=em20251031-2791&t=4&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&refcode=em20251031-2791&amount=3&t=5&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)
I’ll be on the ground knocking doors, leading canvass launches, and amplifying our candidates' messages during these final days. Unfortunately it’s a lot harder to raise money while I am on the road. I’m asking for $3 not just for our three candidates with elections on Tuesday but to protect our independence from corporate special interests. Too many in DC solely rely on wealthy donors or corporations who benefit from pollution and predatory corporate practices that are good for profits but horrible for the people.
Your grassroots support lets us back candidates who hold special interests accountable and who don't take corporate money. We don’t serve the 1% we serve the 99%, and we’re building a movement to prove integrity in politics still exists. **[So if you can, please help us protect that independence and support our candidates by donating just $3 or more.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&refcode=em20251031-2791&amount=3&t=6&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)** I know this is a long email but I really want you to understand how important your support is and that it truly does matter.
Now that I have told you what your support can do, let me tell you about who we are supporting and where I am going to be this week turning out voters for them:
My first stop is in **Houston** to help **Christian Menefee** win his race for Congress.
As Harris County Attorney, Christian sued businesses price-gouging families during a hurricane — and he won. He held Union Pacific accountable for toxic contamination harming people’s health — and he won. He’s also sued the Trump administration multiple times for cutting federal funding to essential programs in his community — and won. He’s the kind of leader who never backs down and always fights for his community.
Up next, I’ll be in **Atlanta** to rally with **Akbar Ali.**
At just 21, Akbar runs a small business, organizes for public education and affordability, and serves as First Vice Chair of the Gwinnett County Democratic Party. If he wins his race for the State House, he’ll be the youngest member of the Georgia General Assembly.
Finally, I’ll close out in **NYC,** helping **Zohran Mamdani** cross the finish line.
Zohran embodies everything Leaders We Deserve is about. He’s proving that a new generation of young leaders _can_ win and deliver real change. He’s energizing young people and tackling the Big Apple’s affordability crisis head-on.
This is going to be an exciting weekend, Peter — and it’s all thanks to you. We don’t take a dime of corporate PAC money. Without your support, helping elect these leaders wouldn’t be possible.
We’re going all in to win these races on Election Day, but we need your help to secure victories on Tuesday and build momentum for 2026 and beyond.
**[So I’m asking everyone reading this to chip in — $3 — to help build a new generation of leaders.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&refcode=em20251031-2791&amount=3&t=7&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)**
**[Donate $3 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251031_1_3for3.aV9xTt&amount=3&refcode=em20251031-2791&t=26&akid=2791%2E587540%2EpSPrZe)**
Thank you. Let’s win together, Peter.
— David

# Vance and Airline CEOs hammer Democrats over shutdown fueled safety concerns
Major U.S. airlines including Delta, American Airlines and United in a meeting with Vice President JD Vance **[implored Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/22512701-a55a-425e-9624-3f3e868977cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to end the four-week Democrat initiated shutdown after air traffic controllers missed their first full paychecks, warning of mounting safety risks and holiday travel chaos amid chronic staffing shortages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22512701-a55a-425e-9624-3f3e868977cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Missed Paychecks Spark Urgency** : Controllers and TSA officers, deemed essential, worked without October 28ths pay amid the shutdown starting on October 1, fueling a bipartisan White House roundtable with airline CEOs.
* **Staffing Crisis Compounds Risks** : FAA faces a 3,800-controller shortfall, forcing mandatory overtime; union warns financial stress distracts from safety, eroding airspace reliability daily.
* **Holiday Havoc Looms Large** : The upcoming record travel season is threatened by potential delays and cancellations. Unlike 2018 shutdown's severe disruptions, current airport bottlenecks signal an escalation.
* **CEOs Highlight Fuel Crisis:** Executives warned Vance that escalating jet fuel prices, up 25% year-over-year, **[could force route cuts and layoffs](https://substack.com/redirect/a2bd187f-20ab-4b7c-99b9-6c41cc2d30a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** without federal intervention.
* **Vance Pledges Policy Support:** The vice president committed to prioritizing aviation subsidies in upcoming budget talks, citing airlines' role in economic connectivity.
* **Future Collaboration Teased:** Leaders discussed joint lobbying efforts with Congress, aiming for tax credits on sustainable fuels to green operations by 2030.

# Goldman CEO trashes the last 25 years of US-China policy as a "mistake"
In a **[fiery FOX Business interview,](https://substack.com/redirect/27455358-2361-44e5-a88e-d6b9ea3ac410?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon branded five decades of U.S.-China trade policy a colossal blunder, while hailing the Trump-Xi summit in South Korea as a pivotal step toward fairer deals amid soaring tariff threats and export curbs.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/01cf26e3-6b4b-45a3-846b-b99f105bcb0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Past Policy Flawed Engagement** : Solomon decries U.S. strategy of open participation without safeguards, fostering unfair trade imbalances over 50 years.
* **Summit Yields Trade Truce** : The Trump-Xi talks secure China's soybean buys, fentanyl crackdown pledges, and U.S. tariff reductions on Chinese imports.
* **No Decoupling Foreseen** : Despite tensions, Solomon anticipates ongoing economic ties, urging reciprocal rules for balanced superpower interactions.

* * *
* * *
# Buy-now-pay-later firm Affirm just got a $750m off "balance sheet loan"
In a bold expansion of their alliance, buy-now-pay-later giant Affirm on Thursday **[secured a $750 million loan](https://substack.com/redirect/b70969fd-f3df-4fa0-948a-61a0ffd27c77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** purchase deal from New York Life Insurance, unlocking funding for $1.75 billion in annual consumer installment loans through 2026 and signaling insurers' rush into **[high-yield fintech assets.](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec2ff35-2292-4d93-bfb1-9b1be38bfdf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70969fd-f3df-4fa0-948a-61a0ffd27c77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Partnership Roots Deepen Ties** : Building on its 2023 origins, New York Life has invested nearly $2 billion in Affirm's collateral pools, marking sustained confidence in its lending model.
* **Off-Balance Boosts Capacity** : **[The off-balance-sheet financing](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec2ff35-2292-4d93-bfb1-9b1be38bfdf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** empowers Affirm to scale lending without straining its core finances, mirroring deals with partners like Liberty Mutual and PGIM.
* **Insurer Appetite Fuels Trend** : Traditional giants like New York Life chase stable, higher yields in consumer finance as interest rates fall, echoing Klarna's pacts with Nelnet and PayPal's $7 billion Blue Owl venture.
* **Economic Tailwinds Aid Growth** : With solid spending and declining delinquencies--bolstered by 90% repeat borrowers--Affirm eyes robust expansion despite **[lingering subprime credit cautions](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec2ff35-2292-4d93-bfb1-9b1be38bfdf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

* * *
* * *
# Walmart pushes back on TikTok rumor about EBT looting
Walmart on Thursday **[debunked viral TikTok rumors](https://substack.com/redirect/5c984772-e10e-41a3-ae41-7564a543bd7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** claiming it would shutter all stores on Nov. 1 amid threats of mass looting if federal SNAP benefits lapse due to the prolonged Democrat shutdown of the government, assuring customers it will remain fully open for in-store shopping.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5c984772-e10e-41a3-ae41-7564a543bd7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rumors Sparked TikTok Frenzy** : Viral videos amassed millions of views, falsely alleged that Walmart would restrict access to online-only amid "brokie" threats of raiding stores for food if SNAP expires Saturday.
* **TikTok Cracks Down Swiftly** : Platform removed misleading clips for violating guidelines on harmful misinformation and curbed search visibility to prevent further spread of panic-inducing falsehoods.
* **Shutdown Hits SNAP Hard** : Ongoing fifth-week federal impasse risks halting aid for 40 million Americans, fueling billions in grocery spending and prompting law enforcement alerts on potential unrest at big-box retailers.
* **Economy Faces Foggy Outlook** : Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell warns prolonged shutdown clouds economic visibility, exacerbating fears of disrupted consumer patterns and broader instability from benefit disruptions.

* * *
* * *
# Samsung goes all in on Nvidia for next gen mobile chip production
Samsung Electronics announced Thursday it will deploy Nvidia GPUs in a **[groundbreaking"AI Megafactory"](https://substack.com/redirect/486c68ce-6dc5-46cf-8935-35b50d58e65e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to automate chip production for mobile devices and robots, partnering with Nvidia to slash manufacturing times and supercharge South Korea's AI ambitions amid a global tech surge.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/486c68ce-6dc5-46cf-8935-35b50d58e65e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **GPU Cluster Deployment** : Samsung is procuring 50,000 Nvidia GPUs to automate semiconductor lithography, targeting efficiency gains for device and robotics chips.
* **Performance Leap Achieved** : The partnership intends to optimize Samsung's platform for a 20-fold speed boost, integrating Nvidia's Omniverse software for AI model simulations.
* **Memory Tech Adaptation** : Samsung is tweaking their fourth-generation High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) for Nvidia AI chips, enhancing the HBM used in advanced computing applications.
* **Korea AI Momentum** : Initiative follows Nvidia CEO's Seoul meetings, mirroring 50,000-GPU deployments by SK Group and Hyundai to fuel national AI leadership.

* * *
# Netflix drops a 10-1 stock split as shares break $1100
Netflix announced Wednesday a **[10-for-1 stock split](https://substack.com/redirect/5978fcd4-092a-4ef9-b91c-9c740b26726d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , set to distribute additional shares Nov. 14 to holders as of Nov. 10, with trading on the adjusted price beginning Nov. 17--aiming to slash its $1,089 share price and broaden access for everyday investors and employees amid 42% year-to-date gains.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5978fcd4-092a-4ef9-b91c-9c740b26726d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Boosting Employee Stock Access** : The split targets affordability for staff in Netflix's option program, countering the stock's elite $1,000-plus S&P 500 status without altering company value.
* **Third Historic Company Split** : The split marks Netflix's latest move after 2004 and 2015 stock actions, reflecting sustained growth as streaming pioneer over two decades.
* **After-Hours Surge Reaction** : Shares jumped over 2% post-announcement, building on five-year rally that further cements Netflix's market dominance.

subject: Update from AG Dan Rayfield
body:
SNAP benefits, National Guard, Supreme Court, and more
---
| | | |
---
|
# It's been a busy few weeks at the Oregon Department of Justice.
This week, our team is in court defending Oregon's sovereignty: making our case for why the federal government’s deployment of National Guard in Oregon is unlawful and unnecessary. Next week, we'll be fighting for working families and small businesses at the U.S. Supreme Court: arguing that the president's tariffs are an abuse of executive power that's harming all of us. (This is the first time Oregon has taken a case to the Supreme Court in over a decade - and a special shoutout to our Solicitor General, Ben Gutman, who's hard at work preparing.) Scroll down for even more:
* Our latest lawsuit protecting SNAP benefits
* A new Economic Justice Section & Working Families Unit
* An upcoming town hall in Corvallis
* Highlights from our first 9 months defending Oregon's laws & values

With gratitude, Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General
---
| |
* * *
---
|
# Protecting SNAP benefits
This is the first time in our history that a president has used food benefits as a political tool. In Oregon, 450,000 families - and over 214,000 children - receive SNAP benefits. Gov. Kotek has directed $5 million to Oregon food banks, and we filed a lawsuit to release the federal SNAP funds - because no one should go hungry because the government refuses to follow the law. [Watch the video explaining why this is so important.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fagdanrayfield.bsky.social%2Fpost%2F3m4ck2dltvk2h/1/0101019a3b865bb0-a9c9a431-532b-485c-97d6-bed0ee67b36f-000000/1TBlgS_g78Wd5xTF3WTg0wlPJrCgxsK8_xzNAO2VVxU=429)

# Preventing unlawful National Guard deployment
When the federal government tried to federalize and deploy National Guard troops to Oregon in late September, we filed a lawsuit in less than 6 hours. Our two Temporary Restraining Orders preventing deployment are still in effect. This week, we’re in trial putting on evidence proving the federal government’s deployment of National Guard is unlawful and unnecessary. We will continue to fight for Oregonians' rights and the safety of our communities every day. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fstories%2Fhighlights%2F17932092980981865%2F/1/0101019a3b865bb0-a9c9a431-532b-485c-97d6-bed0ee67b36f-000000/60MYjJ3rslJSCoOY9Av8B4OlvT42Edo6XpzziPCbod0=429)

We're fighting every day for seniors, children, consumers, and families in our state. That's why we recently announced a new Economic Justice Section at the Oregon DOJ, including a new Working Families Unit. [Learn more](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fattorney-general-rayfield-doubles-down-on-protecting-oregonians-against-scams-predatory-practices%2F/1/0101019a3b865bb0-a9c9a431-532b-485c-97d6-bed0ee67b36f-000000/ySPbC1XKjhEcjlOtBFWmw_qYdLlLDnGwCW2uBFAI55k=429).

clean_body: SNAP benefits, National Guard, Supreme Court, and more | | | | | It's been a busy few weeks at the Oregon Department of Justice. This week, our team is in court defending Oregon's sovereignty: making our case for why the federal government’s deployment of National Guard in Oregon is unlawful and unnecessary. Next week, we'll be fighting for working families and small businesses at the U.S. Supreme Court: arguing that the president's tariffs are an abuse of executive power that's harming all of us. (This is the first time Oregon has taken a case to the Supreme Court in over a decade - and a special shoutout to our Solicitor General, Ben Gutman, who's hard at work preparing.) Scroll down for even more: Our latest lawsuit protecting SNAP benefits A new Economic Justice Section & Working Families Unit An upcoming town hall in Corvallis Highlights from our first 9 months defending Oregon's laws & values With gratitude, Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General | | | Protecting SNAP benefits This is the first time in our history that a president has used food benefits as a political tool. In Oregon, 450,000 families - and over 214,000 children - receive SNAP benefits. Gov. Kotek has directed $5 million to Oregon food banks, and we filed a lawsuit to release the federal SNAP funds - because no one should go hungry because the government refuses to follow the law. | | | | Preventing unlawful National Guard deployment When the federal government tried to federalize and deploy National Guard troops to Oregon in late September, we filed a lawsuit in less than 6 hours. Our two Temporary Restraining Orders preventing deployment are still in effect. This week, we’re in trial putting on evidence proving the federal government’s deployment of National Guard is unlawful and unnecessary. We will continue to fight for Oregonians' rights and the safety of our communities every day. | | | Corvallis Town Hall on November 12 We're launching a new town hall series - the Oregon Priorities Tour \- and our next town hall will be Wednesday, November 12 in Corvallis at 6pm. Come share the priorities that matter most to you and your family: keeping communities safe, protecting working families, consumers and seniors, defending Oregon’s values, or something else. | | | Fighting for working families We're fighting every day for seniors, children, consumers, and families in our state. That's why we recently announced a new Economic Justice Section at the Oregon DOJ, including a new Working Families Unit. . | | | Defending Oregon's values The Oregon Department of Justice is working every day to defend Oregon's values - including protecting Oregon from federal overreach. To date, we have safeguarded over $4.4 billion in federal dollars coming to our state through our lawsuits. Learn more about . Track specific lawsuits in our . | | | Recap: 9 months in office In our first 9 months in office, we've delivered some key wins for Oregon: keeping our communities safe, protecting working families, seniors, and consumers, protecting Oregon’s values, and hearing from Oregonians across the state. | | | We want to hear from you! | | Dear Friend,
As your voice in Lansing, I’ve made it my mission to protect the way of life that makes Michigan so special, especially here in Northern Michigan, where our communities depend on responsible stewardship of our land and natural resources.
But the truth is, the Department of Natural Resources (DNR) doesn’t just impact one region, its reach extends across our entire state. From farm fields and forests to lakes and public lands, the DNR’s decisions affect how every Michigander lives, works, and enjoys the outdoors.
That’s why I’ve been working hard to hold the DNR accountable and ensure that it serves the people, not the other way around. I’ve fought to bring transparency, local input, and balance to a department that too often acts without listening to those who know our communities best.
We’ve made progress, but there’s still more work to do. I need your help to keep fighting for common sense, balance, and accountability in the Department of Natural Resources.
Your support powers this fight. Will you join me by making a contribution today?
[👉 **Chip in $25 , $50, $100 or any amount**](https://brightsparkstrategies.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f3a7dccdb3ca90c7483cf93d3&id=65f3d1b6b8&e=9ec31248a9)
Together, we can protect our state’s natural beauty while standing up for the people and communities that make Michigan strong.
Thank you,
**Ken Borton**
State Representative

They need to know about scandals like Beetlejuice. | | | | | == | Peter, Lauren Boebert is ridiculously unpopular with the people of Colorado, especially those in her district. The scandals are piling up and her immorality and dishonesty have alienated her from even her most extreme far-right supporters. Case in point - she just reported her lowest fundraising haul ever - a meager $110,000 dollars, no one wants to support her any more. She is in Congress because of just 546 votes and had to flee her old district because she was about to be booted out. Her new constituents see her as a carpetbagger. One of the key scandals that forced her to abandon her old district was the 2023 Beetlejuice Incident in which the Congresswoman was escorted out of a showing of Beetlejuice: The Musical after belligerently hitting a weed vape pen and committing a lewd act with her date in the theater. | == In 2024 she had the worst performance a republican has ever had in our district, tens of thousands of CO-04 GOP voters voted for Trump but refused to vote for her. They refused because these voters know who she is and it turned them off. The key to winning this district and beating Boebert is simply telling voters who she is. Once you do that they avoid her like the plague. Boebert's new constituents who don't know her need to know about scandals like Beetlejuice. Friend,**I’m running for Congress because leadership should keep people safe—not march us toward the next cliff because it polls well.****Right now we’re living with the fallout of performative, poll-driven politics:** foreign crises that escalate instead of resolve, and domestic policing that treats neighborhoods like war zones. Parents are fielding hard questions from their kids. Workers are wondering if their rights and dignity will be protected. Communities of color are asked, yet again, to trust systems that have failed them.**I believe in a different kind of leadership—evidence-based, people-centered, and accountable.** That means diplomacy first, real limits on executive overreach, and alliances grounded in human rights. It also means investing in what actually keeps people safe: mental health care, addiction treatment, youth opportunity, and transparent, constitutional policing.**The current administration keeps following a pied piper—chasing headlines, letting lobbyists steer, and calling it strategy**. I won’t do that. I’m a science-minded mom from Missouri. My compass is data, decency, and the lived experience of the people I serve.**Tonight’s our end-of-month deadline. If you want leadership that won’t be led off a cliff, I need you with me now.** Grassroots donations keep this campaign independent and focused on people, not PACs.[**Can you chip in $10, $25, or $50 before midnight?**](https://bethanymannforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8503c326f96dced21eb78651f&id=f27deb22c0&e=519ef02502) Every dollar you give keeps this campaign free to make tough, clear-eyed choices—guided by values, not vibes.

**With hope,****Bethany Mann**

body:
VoteVets has spent millions of dollars taking the fight to the Trump Administration and Republicans around the country this year. We are holding them accountable and forcing them into failure. We’ve got plans to do even more. But right now, our fundraising is plummeting
#
Peter,
We can’t downplay the stakes of this moment.
Our democracy is under siege like never before.
Donald Trump has deployed federal law enforcement and Guard Troops to multiple American cities.
He is mobilizing and weaponizing the entire federal government against his political opponents and American cities – people he and his administration have labeled domestic extremists.
He has literally gilded the Oval Office, he's forcing a government shutdown, and he's bragging about all of it while American families, Active Duty, and Veterans alike see the price of groceries, rent, health care, and utilities go far beyond what they can afford.
And now, he is getting ready to lead our nation into another Forever War – this time in Venezuela.
It's a terrible moment. But what we do now still matters. And VoteVets is not shying away from the fight.
VoteVets has spent millions of dollars taking the fight to the Trump Administration and Republicans around the country this year. We are holding them accountable and forcing them into failure. We’ve got plans to do even more. But right now, our fundraising is plummeting.
We need to see a surge in donations if we’re going to keep this up. And to do that, we really need your help.

Hi friend, Growing up in Michigan, Halloween has always come with one big debate: **coat or no coat.** If you know, you know – it’s (almost!) always freezing on Halloween, and my mom had a strict rule that we had to wear coats over our costumes. I wanted to share a quick note to give you a glimpse of what a typical morning for your Congressman looks like – when Congressman Harder starts out the morning as just “Dada”. Every morning in our house is a small circus. This morning, Lillian, our 3-year-old, was mad that she couldn’t find pants that were both sparkly AND had rainbow colors. Josh talked her down from tears by finding a sparkly shirt and convinced her it was better to have the sparkles on the shirt. Meanwhile, Karina, our 1-year-old, is gleefully enjoying the independence of our new cereal dispensers, leaving a trail of Cheerios that Josh then vacuums up while also singing “ba, ba, blacksheep.” In the backdrop, I am cutting up fruits into tiny bite sized pieces for lunchboxes, while Josh is searching for two tiny matching shoes in the big shoe pile. We miraculously make it out of the door on time. Then, he heads straight to fight for families like ours in Congress – making sure parents can find affordable childcare, fighting to lower costs, and protecting our democracy so our daughters can grow up in a country that lives up to its promise. **I see how much it weighs on him when the news is tough or when the attacks get personal. But he never gives up - because he believes in the good we can do together and in the people he’s fighting for. As a husband, as a dad, and as a leader, I couldn’t be prouder of him.** [_**Tonight is Josh’s end-of-month deadline, and I know he’s worried about hitting his goal before we take the kids trick-or-treating. If you can, will you chip in now so Josh can keep fighting for families like ours?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118407287/579653073/-596618888?&refcode=E16005-20251031-PamEmail-SL-Surrogate&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTljMDkwOGItOGViNi1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wo2Oj9nuufFivm0eOWTeSKFbGOaSfoOdVhexJbe6CH4=) Thank you for standing with our family. It truly means the world to us. With gratitude, Pam

Peter,

My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. **I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. _This is my story._**

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter, My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. This is my story. In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do. Before becoming the 2nd in command in Virginia, I beat a 20-year incumbent in 2001 to become the first Republican to win a seat in a majority black district in the Virginia House of Delegates since 1865. In the General Assembly, I focused on getting results for my constituents. Prior to my career in politics, I had the distinct honor of serving as an electrician in the United States Marine Corps. It was here that I learned to be a leader--to improvise, adapt, and overcome. Looking back, my time in the Marines had a significant impact on who I am today, and for that, I'm ever grateful. Looking even further back, when I was just 6 years old, my family and I came to the United States from Jamaica. We arrived in a new land with no money and different accents, but we made it work and got through the struggles - only in America is something like this even possible. Of course, none of this would have been possible without my husband, Terence, and my amazing daughters. ## Dog Helps Woman Wake from Coma
A Florida woman [credits a golden retriever](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DvO2zAQBODTSB0N7pLWo2CRxp3TpiRo7VJiwocg0Rbk0wf2Ff56gBl88-du7y7EkOffLrHxs7fVF5v52CPXypulMh_uH-_P9SjJZb-VNJXk5mBR4lWAFAosuRBPq1synhlZtWyg72DUIOXQLmaUelJ9pxGvoCZ8DNCDvOLoPT3UMLg2mE8bSAUopcLuogCd7-DRk0buPTVaMoVatsvfEnJd2MezvHi7TCW10Sy1rnujfjV4a_C2clkjf6IGb3Xhza2noDKL_Hy_I-_iSxGJKUwuxlOETM-JSXxkoi6cxeIyiVReTAJgUN0IY7sZWo8QY9i7vtFyTi7E73798XEvg_8DAAD__9uEhIU) named Scrunchie with helping her wake from a medically induced coma after surviving a massive medical crisis. Priscilla Timmons, 39, suffered a pulmonary embolism in March that triggered three cardiac arrests and organ failure, leaving her with just a 10% chance of survival. While Priscilla was still [unresponsive in the ICU](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMlC7DWYIHFxCNpdeiHrsNvjWxsh4BvH3K_YXNiuppCq99-85P8kHvy1_KbJ2i5uLS_PG5xG4FM6zTctJX3y89zNF2lxO0aRIi58RsG8ENFLMlny45q622jEjy5q1GJQYOwHwqFdtRxpH7ntiScPDGDQP6ZR8EYAaRkW11_eaACkQQKJqpUBySrwG2yEPzlYdsPUl5fZ_8ltZ2YUrfTi3JsU66LWU_ajknwqnCqfzPNuL1pTutsLpxqlwoly8CXzH2ESfyQRuXmzofXBTVs60X41NS4PQCwAlRbuWGOqs7X76EPyhhqqDJZIPP7_l18I-Gr8DAAD__yMggW0), Scrunchie, one of the hospital's therapy dogs, nuzzled her hand, prompting her first movement and sparking her recovery. Priscilla spent 21 days in intensive care and has since returned to thank the care team--and the therapy dogs--who supported her fight back to life. [Watch a video of Priscilla petting Scrunchie](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuwyAUgOHT4C0WPLBJBoYO8VAp3aqOCIcHpgUTAQnK7av0Cp1_6Rv-r4u-mBDD7j9MQuW8081lvWOvEVvDom323fxgvd96TmZ3JadrTsYHDRSmA6MHzrQ1IT61GKxyiIB8QMXkzE6CUXocNmW55JKjcW6SZl3p8cgFP60UThatNNMQ1EtjlDOglMM8cgbGzWyVVgBKZ4mgaEPLZfzOYW8buvjMDyzjNachqq21WyX8jcBCYOm9j898b_cVX53AUrdcWiWwfF7KdHg_-6s_D0XZWw8xhjpLIqhPJsQ_r_17xEPBbwAAAP__Lidz4w).
## Minnesota Mom Saves Kids From Burning Bus
A quick-thinking mom in Minnesota is being recognized for her bravery after she helped [rescue 22 elementary students](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkE2u2yAURleDZ9eCi38HDF5VeVLldeBKGVrEXGwabCJDQt3VV-kW3vzTp3PO9TJdtPNuXz71Rsoudko2TDvl6CklOiYTlqzvFJ-PHDa92yNsc9j04ibkWIPgIMVktPPnVBVGWSIkWZASbSP6SnDeFavCrubS9jeBsmuJ93U3Ezd8FiRaOTe8cOr9JrgUyLnEppQCtW3ErTUVUmsNqzgZl8JR_g5uTytZf4YXHeUctsKrNaVHZPKD4cBwyDmX8bnvZ7yff98LhsMSgoG3F8Oh7ivBcBhXglFn-IBxXkPw8O0Z4ecOgzsIrqtO8Gt1ES5hg-_OwCf9STDqFxlAhB_OxOJQ5pGd9y42Lav4smnn_xOlL6d8KfwXAAD__yWYiLs) from a school bus that caught fire. Kari Thorp spotted smoke and flames coming from the bus outside her home and ran toward it, alerting the driver. Together, they evacuated the children just moments before the bus was engulfed in flames. [Her Ring camera](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O3SAURFeDO57ggv8KijTuvlSRUlrYXPBNwFiYZ-vtPnKaLCDtGWk0c35-zV-WIu3hu01ofPBz9Xne8T4j1opldjnc9jee7-POye6-5LTmZAPNIKDlUnAlZ2cpfmbdOOMRAVWDRvadHLUUYmg2s_qxG6Fdhn4YwbsVdbtoBa2zKLxXsiHztEmhJAihoHspCdZ3cumdBuy9Y1qgo5rL61emvW7o4ydfWF5rTk00W63HydQ3BhODyS7r8-AV8hMzmO5couMP4zXvFLbKb6obd_Yix9Obyg8G00UOM4PpH-UFj1zqyVNO_LQX7YED8HWj6ArufHmfXEI36LFVsinGHTfFSGfXMy1CshT_7qv_LfYy8CcAAP__Cy2QPA) later showed the kids safely gathered outside as tires exploded and the fire spread. Parents and school officials have praised both adults for their fast, fearless response.
## Dogs Airlifted After Alaska Floods
A nonprofit in western Alaska [has rescued at least 180 dogs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOiN77UBSuPgbuvztlcjgXbMXY0fYCcrbn7hXuG6kkT7NfF_36e44cgr_3YaWAk2V8pTwKBFrxX3yORzugeX1PPLmEu15W_LmAk8g4SKUFFpN3nH8TKb1lhABdYtWDb26GSXltV2tXkj3sjd6JoXDzUu46Ju5Gpiv5CX1LduTpqRWIKWGvtMKHPVqHrwBHMg3RqLnmvfuO3OqK1L85Dfu3ZK3Ntq11mdp9L8GxgbG4zi6ZS7ni7NvYDxjA6OLrjyc8DmIHcvywiJmrCtGQTtj8kVkEotLnLAIijl7TkG8OUYX8AS0u_XPg2Pk0g-NkWFzHH831D_Le1v4CQAA__-tOYc_)--and one classroom turtle--after flooding from Typhoon Halong left remote villages underwater and cut off. [Bethel Friends of Canines](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1ygzAQQOHTQGdGf0ZOoSKNO6dNqVnYXdhESB5QrPHtM84V0r_5ivd5izeQJHn5gI0CLxwrl5ipHYlqpT1iWRp80_Fzb2WDzHvZ5rLBItEocz5pdbI6Ikh6RtdjYCJDtqeg_ajfnFbq0q-BncdJXyZCh7Mf0XsLl_kMZmLgGaiX8NK0stooZc04WG2ARz15dIY8Y-cUodSyD19Fcl2J07M8aB_msvUprLXej86-d-bamWtrbZiorpR4F8p4FJ4hS6bjlXfm2u8B701SkmP0nVPLBpL-qPrvB49gfgMAAP__Vkp0TA), with help from pilots and locals, has been airlifting animals out using whatever's available, including backpacks and plastic totes. Most of the dogs are being reunited with their families, while unclaimed pets are placed in foster care or [posted online for ID](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuszAQwPGngS3IPgzON3j4WoktXTtaF3wHbowvAjdW3r5KX6H7X7_h_3nxF4wp5uUDN3K8sC8sPlM9EpVCuw-yVLzR8X2vsmHmXbZZNlyiBwXDSatTr33AmJ7etMExEVDfktN21P-MVurcro4JDAzICs9hCIbtOABamNFYsnS1bXQvTateg1I9jF2vAXnUVxsMkOXQGEUhFtm7L4m5rMTpKQ_au1m2Nrm1lPvR9P8bmBqYaq0d40xXkdsraGB6o7JSmvZIORzC75hjpqPdXbjXmFI8RtsYtWwY0y9Z_vzi4eAnAAD__x7ddjg). The group is still responding to calls, especially for dogs that are scared and hiding in the debris. "_Everyone knows everyone 's dog_," one volunteer said. And they're not quitting until every last one is found.

subject: ICE overreach, corporate greed, and what we’re doing about it
body:
Standing up to fear. Standing with people

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=7cb4c875a2&e=5a6ee82cdb)
| | | | | |
Dear Peter,
We’re hours away from the end of the month—and I’m asking for your help to close it out strong.This campaign has never taken a dime from corporate PACs, AIPAC, or any group trying to buy influence. We’ve built it the right way: with real conversations, grassroots support, and a clear message that power belongs with the people—not the highest bidder.Here’s what we advanced this month:
* **Exposing ICE overreach:** When families in our communities are living in fear, that’s not safety—it’s state-sponsored intimidation. I participated in **Anti-ICE training with DSA organizers** to strengthen our coalition response, share de-escalation tactics, and protect our neighbors from unconstitutional raids.

* **Health and economic security:** Families deserve stability—affordable healthcare, fair wages, and protection from policies that put profit over people.

* **Elevating our message nationally:** I’ve been interviewed by _Axios_ to make one thing clear—Democrats can win without corporate money if we fight for working families and mean it.

* **Grassroots fundraising that reflects our values:** This month, hundreds of small-dollar donors stepped up to keep this campaign people-powered, transparent, and independent.

Our end-of-month goal is within reach, and your contribution before **11:59 PM tonight** will help us finish strong and send a message that people-first politics isn’t just possible—it’s winning.Every dollar you give protects our independence and keeps this campaign rooted in real people’s lives. [**Let’s finish October strong with your donation of $15, $25, $50, or whatever you can give.**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=0033312860&e=5a6ee82cdb)

I am deeply appreciative of the outpouring of support I received following the announcement that a wealthy venture capitalist with deep pockets was trying to buy our Congressional seat.

Unfortunately, after calling all of his ultra wealthy friends outside our district and bankrolling his campaign with nearly $150,000 of his money, **we were outraised last quarter.**

Peter, I’m going to be honest. Campaigns are expensive. To win this race we’ll need to invest in TV ads, direct mail, digital ads, supporting our volunteers as they knock on doors and make phone calls, and more. This will be even more crucial when we pass Prop 50 and I’m facing a new district where I’ll have to introduce myself to new voters.

**But, I know that together, we can win.**

My team and I are working very hard to raise the resources needed to compete and win this election cycle, so that I can continue our work together to address our district’s most pressing needs. But I need your help.

_Governor Braun Calls Costly Special Session on Redistricting to Serve His DC Bosses, Not Hoosiers_
[__](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412189/579669186/-980094173?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzI0MjIzYS05OWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ka4SGY8Ko7Cm1sGYvD92Upi0H3NrTWaoQYTBQeFowZg=&emci=c4950d39-97b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7724223a-99b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535) On Monday morning, Governor Mike Braun officially announced that he was calling the Indiana General Assembly into a special session. Special sessions are reserved for state emergencies, but that didn’t stop Governor Braun from calling a session that will cost $30,000/day on redrawing Indiana’s congressional districts mid-decade. The bottom line is that Governor Braun lied to Hoosiers. He said throughout this process that he would listen to Indiana’s legislators before making a decision to call a session. Just last week, and again this week. Indiana Senate Republican leadership has said publicly that they “don’t have the votes” on redistricting. By calling this session, Braun has broken his promise to Hoosiers. Continue to call your state senators daily to oppose this power grab: (317) 232-9400. We still do not know the first day of the special session, but we will continue providing you with the latest information on the session. ****_Trump and Braun Block Emergency SNAP Benefits for Hoosiers in Need_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412190/579669187/-1671309561?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzI0MjIzYS05OWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ka4SGY8Ko7Cm1sGYvD92Upi0H3NrTWaoQYTBQeFowZg=&emci=c4950d39-97b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7724223a-99b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535) Due to the ongoing government shutdown, SNAP benefits are expected to lapse tomorrow for over 600,000 Hoosiers, meaning that they won’t get the food assistance they need for November. In response, Democratic local officials across Indiana are stepping up to make sure Hoosiers don’t go hungry. Local efforts led by Democratic township trustees in [Valparaiso](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412191/579669188/-376818477?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzI0MjIzYS05OWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ka4SGY8Ko7Cm1sGYvD92Upi0H3NrTWaoQYTBQeFowZg=&emci=c4950d39-97b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7724223a-99b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535), [South Bend](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412192/579669189/-954292935?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzI0MjIzYS05OWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ka4SGY8Ko7Cm1sGYvD92Upi0H3NrTWaoQYTBQeFowZg=&emci=c4950d39-97b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7724223a-99b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535), and elsewhere show that Hoosier Democrats are bringing together the community to make sure the gridlock in DC doesn’t cause chaos for Hoosiers. At the Statehouse, Democrats proposed using surplus state funds to make sure SNAP benefits continue for November, but the proposal was voted down by Republicans. And now, a federal judge has ordered this administration to release the contingency SNAP funds meant for this situation. It’s time for President Trump to stop games and fund SNAP. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412193/579669190/1044279882?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzI0MjIzYS05OWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ka4SGY8Ko7Cm1sGYvD92Upi0H3NrTWaoQYTBQeFowZg=&emci=c4950d39-97b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7724223a-99b6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535) The games and chaos in Washington D.C. doesn’t have to cripple Hoosier families. That’s the message our state legislators sent this week by calling on Governor Braun to use state surplus funds – the same money which is often allocated to IEDC – to make sure SNAP benefits do not expire in November. However, the proposal to the State Budget Committee was voted down by a 3-2 margin. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Governor Braun Calls Costly Special Session on Redistricting to Serve His DC Bosses, Not Hoosiers On Monday morning, Governor Mike Braun officially announced that he was calling the Indiana General Assembly into a special session. Special sessions are reserved for state emergencies, but that didn’t stop Governor Braun from calling a session that will cost $30,000/day on redrawing Indiana’s congressional districts mid-decade. The bottom line is that Governor Braun lied to Hoosiers. He said throughout this process that he would listen to Indiana’s legislators before making a decision to call a session. Just last week, and again this week. Indiana Senate Republican leadership has said publicly that they “don’t have the votes” on redistricting. By calling this session, Braun has broken his promise to Hoosiers. Continue to call your state senators daily to oppose this power grab: (317) 232-9400. We still do not know the first day of the special session, but we will continue providing you with the latest information on the session. Trump and Braun Block Emergency SNAP Benefits for Hoosiers in Need Due to the ongoing government shutdown, SNAP benefits are expected to lapse tomorrow for over 600,000 Hoosiers, meaning that they won’t get the food assistance they need for November. In response, Democratic local officials across Indiana are stepping up to make sure Hoosiers don’t go hungry. Local efforts led by Democratic township trustees in , , and elsewhere show that Hoosier Democrats are bringing together the community to make sure the gridlock in DC doesn’t cause chaos for Hoosiers. At the Statehouse, Democrats proposed using surplus state funds to make sure SNAP benefits continue for November, but the proposal was voted down by Republicans. And now, a federal judge has ordered this administration to release the contingency SNAP funds meant for this situation. It’s time for President Trump to stop games and fund SNAP. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. The games and chaos in Washington D.C. doesn’t have to cripple Hoosier families. That’s the message our state legislators sent this week by calling on Governor Braun to use state surplus funds – the same money which is often allocated to IEDC – to make sure SNAP benefits do not expire in November. However, the proposal to the State Budget Committee was voted down by a 3-2 margin. We will continue to make sure that every avenue is explored to keep these SNAP benefits in place for the Hoosier children who need them. There’s no reason why we shouldn’t be using these funds to feed Hoosier families. | Peter — I know that millions of people who are absolutely disgusted with Donald Trump’s presidency are looking to next month’s election to provide some hope. I know that whether we win or lose — and believe me, it’s looking close — will set the tone for what comes next in 2026, 2028, and beyond. I know that if we lose, Trump will just be emboldened to attack our institutions and our communities even more aggressively. But I also know that if we win, we can start to turn the tide in a better direction. And that we will send a powerful message — to Donald Trump and to the entire country — that the American people do not accept the past nine months of cruelty and authoritarianism as our new normal. Peter, my first and last thought every single day is how much is riding on our success in this election. But together, I know we can get this done. We can show the country who we are and what we stand for — and rally the American people behind a future that is not dictated by Donald Trump and his right-wing allies. [If we’re going to get there, I need your help — because this is a neck-and-neck race, and every single vote will make a difference. Will you split $10 between my team and Blue Amp Action today to help me and New Jersey Democrats win this election and show the country Donald Trump’s dark path doesn’t need to be our future?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5ab895cf-9f54-4d22-a04b-c9e3ab059ad0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. Peter, it’s Valerie Foushee. I hope I caught you before you log off for the evening. Tomorrow marks one month since Republicans shut down the government, and it’s been one month of uncertainty, hardship, and frustration for millions of Americans. Families are struggling to make ends meet, federal workers are missing paychecks, and small businesses that rely on government contracts are hanging by a thread. Meanwhile, Republicans are busy pointing fingers instead of finding solutions. I won’t stand by while people are suffering. I came to Congress to deliver for working families, not to play political games. Enough is enough. If we’re going to lead the way to a new House majority, we have to hit every single fundraising goal through 2026. That includes tonight’s end-of-month deadline, and as of right now, we’re coming up short. Can I personally ask you to pitch in today? We have to put a stop to this chaos and nonsense. Here’s the best link to give if you’re able to: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sbd-vf-em-fr-october25?source=OctoberEOM](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118412629/579670638/1096806550?amount=10&source=SBD_VF_EM_FR_103125_EOM6_180DO_D5_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTk2ZTg3Ni05YWI2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HDbOp94Q9gqwnxUdQZiVEN_mLCDt5w7RphE65s9XIcU=)** Whether you’re able to give today or not, thanks for being in this fight with me. _Issue 136 / October 2025_

| | |

USO Supporter,

As the holidays approach, showing our service members they're not alone is more important than ever. Thanks to supporters like you, the USO can be there wherever duty calls.

This month, we thank our departing CEO, Dr. J.D. Crouch II, for his years of dedicated leadership and service and wish him well in his next chapter. We're also happy to welcome our new CEO, Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Michael Linnington, a distinguished veteran and longtime champion for service members and their families. [**Read Mike 's full biography on the USO website.**](https://links.e.uso.)

| | | USO FRONT LINES
---|---

[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/_K68Qew0RECD/aWJpNzBoT3ZvMkRieHlObWdKU2d1VmZud3JFT0tIMk1vVDVaUHhXeHdwR01JZ2ZqQTRkTFJlVWE3akJrQk80L0NlOWphRVlicDZCdjkrU3R4UlFVQU1kRXREcTA0cVNnRW9xV255OWpMQkk9S0/QTdkcnB6NnpIVnY0UHNoYkVUMWVQdnIvY0YzQjJqOTVKSFJuVnA2b2VKaW5iTG8yYllxaUpwRXhZblZubndWeVlDNk1Pc3ZoaElOa09hT0VUb0U4SzZ5cHIwN2hWOFp3S0)

**Far from Home, Never Alone**
U.S. troops stationed in remote parts of Lithuania face long days and few comforts. The USO's first staffed Center in the Baltic region offers them a place to rest and recharge. With coffee, Wi-Fi, games and the USO Reading Program, the USO Center reminds every service member that even far from home, they're never alone. [**Learn more**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/A-VKBbWP7ph9/aWJpNzBoT3ZvMkRieHlObWdKU2d1VmZud3JFT0tIMk1vVDVaUHhXeHdwR01JZ2ZqQTRkTFJlVWE3akJrQk80L0NlOWphRVlicDZCdjkrU3R4UlFVQU1kRXREcTA0cVNnRW9xV255OWpMQkk9S0/QTdkcnB6NnpIVnY0UHNoYkVUMWVQdnIvY0YzQjJqOTVKSFJuVnA2b2VKaW5iTG8yYllxaUpwRXhZblZubndWeVlDNk1Pc3ZoaElOa09hT0VUb0U4SzZ5cHIwN2hWOFp3S0)

| | | GLOBAL ENTERTAINMENT
---|---

**Illusionist Justin Flom Visits Service Members in Alaska**
World-renowned illusionist Justin Flom brought a touch of magic to Alaska during a five-day USO tour in September, visiting nearly 600 service members stationed across the state. From Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson to Coast Guard Base Kodiak, Justin's visit brought a touch of wonder to one of the most remote regions in the world.

| | | EVENTS
---|---

[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/a9zxSP-0v6H8/aWJpNzBoT3ZvMkRieHlObWdKU2d1VmZud3JFT0tIMk1vVDVaUHhXeHdwR01JZ2ZqQTRkTFJlVWE3akJrQk80L0NlOWphRVlicDZCdjkrU3R4UlFVQU1kRXREcTA0cVNnRW9xV255OWpMQkk9S0/)

**Swing into Action for Our Military Heroes**
We hope you'll join the first-ever USO Golf-A-Thon to play golf, raise funds and support USO programs that keep service members connected to home. [**Sign up or donate today.**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/V7YEHrWwVXsw/aWJpNzBoT3ZvMkRieHlObWdKU2d1VmZud3JFT0tIMk1vVDVaUHhXeHdwR01JZ2ZqQTRkTFJlVWE3akJrQk80L0NlOWphRVlicDZCdjkrU3R4UlFVQU1kRXREcTA0cVNnRW9xV255OWpMQkk9S0/)
* Register online and create your personal fundraising page.
* Set a fundraising goal.
* Play as many rounds or holes as you can.
* Ask friends and family to support your challenge through November.

**Leader Steals the Spotlight at Fort Eustis**
This month, Fort Eustis celebrated Leader, our 2025 USO Canine Volunteer of the Year, with a meet-and-greet where she even "signed" special calendars for our troops. Leader spreads comfort and joy to everyone she meets -- a heartwarming reminder that service can come on four paws.

| | |
---
| | | CORPORATE PARTNERS
---|---

| |
---

This season, these incredible partners are helping strengthen the well-being of service members and their families by providing vital funding for USO programs and services:
* **Bob 's Discount Furniture:** Matching in-store donations in North Carolina dollar for dollar, up to a total of $75,000, and supporting Plushies for Charity
* **Sheetz:** $1 to the USO for every 200 Sheetz Pointz donated in November
* **Winn Dixie & Harveys:** For every pound of Razzle Dazzle Premium Grapes sold from Oct. 1 through Nov. 11, 5¢ will be donated to the USO, up to a total of $50,000.

**Partner Highlight: Navy Federal**

In 2025, Navy Federal supported service members through its partnership with the USO by providing mentorship opportunities, hosting Military Virtual Programming, participating in nationwide Fleet Week events and packing more than 8,000 USO Care Packages across multiple locations.

| | | [](https://links.e.uso.)
---

The USO is there for our troops and their families through every step of their military journey, from the moment they enlist, through every deployment and as they transition back to civilian life. Giving monthly to the USO means making the biggest impact for America's service members and military families.

[**Set up your monthly gift now. >>**](https://links.e.uso.)

our nation's heroes.

subject: Things feel scary right now. Here’s what’s giving me hope.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2692%2E4032634%2Eskpoi6)
---
I love Halloween. I love all the costumes, candy, and trick-or-treating. (So does Bailey, see below.) Today is typically an opportunity to send fun emails using some punny references about how there’s nothing quite as scary as Republicans, private equity vampires, or an end-of-month fundraising deadline. But I have to say that this year feels different. Things feel genuinely scary right now. 42 million Americans who rely on SNAP benefits have been unsure if they can put food on the table next month because of Donald Trump’s choices during the government shutdown. Tens of millions of Americans are about to see their premiums skyrocket because Republicans refuse to extend the Affordable Care Act subsidies that make it possible for people to afford to go to the doctor. Trump is sending masked ICE agents to raid our communities and ordering the National Guard to invade our cities. The administration is using the government shutdown as an excuse to fire federal workers like special education teachers at the Department of Education and CDC researchers who monitor emerging health threats. Media corporations are taking comedians off the air after critiquing the president. Trump is using government power to target and punish political enemies who worked to hold him accountable. It truly is a scary time. And I’m doing everything in my power to stop Trump’s march toward and defend our rights, our democracy, and our future. At the same time, here’s what gives me hope right now: Americans across the country are rising up, speaking out, and fighting back against the unconstitutional power grabs they’re seeing every day from Trump and the GOP. It’s the people who are standing up for their neighbors who are being taken off the streets. It’s the millions of Americans who attended No Kings rallies. It’s the voters who are protesting against Republican attempts to gerrymander in states like Indiana and Missouri. It’s the volunteers who are staying in the fight and organizing for candidates and causes that truly represent working people, not the billionaire class. In a few days, voters will head to the polls to make their voices heard in important elections happening in Virginia, New Jersey, California, New York City, and more. In each of these elections, voters will have a choice of what direction they want to see our country move in. We’ve got a chance to show that we outright reject what Donald Trump and the Republican party is doing. We’ve got a chance to ask: Do we want to continue to put power in the hands of billionaires and billionaire-funded politicians? Or do we want to chart a new path forward and elect leaders who will fight for policies that will make life more affordable and better for all of us? We’re not accepting defeat. We’re still fighting back. And we still believe that our government CAN work for working people. subject: A terrifying new level of voter suppression

body:
While the media has been hyper-focused on the redistricting fights, this case has seemingly flown under the radar -- even though its impact on voting and representation would be a larger swing than all the current redistricting efforts combined.
This decision could knock the last leg out from the VRA, functionally ending a historic piece of legislation and setting our fight for fair representation back decades.
RUSH $25 or more right now to help protect what the VRA stands for and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103125_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
@ariberman.bsky.social: SCOTUS decision killing what’s left of Voting Rights Act could cost Dems 19 House seats, eliminate every majority-minority district in South, eviscerate 14th/15th Amendments & fulfill John Roberts 40-year crusade against country’s most important civil rights law [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103125_3&amount=25]
The impact shows how partisan this all is, Team. A complete dismantling of the Voting Rights Act -- a key civil rights law -- would only harm one political party and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we left behind sixty years ago.
During this month’s oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $25 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103125_3&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
Party news you can use!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ff_oct_3&n=1)
